jobs.description:
OverviewPLEASE NOTE: No corp-to-corp candidates will be accepted.

Overview

PLEASE NOTE: No corp-to-corp candidates will be accepted.

- The Apple/macOS Engineer is responsible for engineering and maintaining the secure macOS endpoint environment, including workstation image development, macOS baseline configuration, JAMF administration, Apple Business Manager integration, macOS device enrollment, patching, compliance, authentication support, logging, and operational documentation.

- This role ensures that macOS endpoints used by on-site and remote users are securely configured, consistently provisioned, fully inventoried, and integrated with VDI, authentication, monitoring, and incident response requirements.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, maintain, and harden standard macOS workstation images for on-site and remote/VDI use.

- Engineer and maintain secure macOS baseline configurations, compliance settings, and lifecycle controls.

- Administer JAMF Pro and Apple Business Manager enrollment and provisioning workflows for macOS devices.

- Support macOS device provisioning, policy deployment, software distribution, patching, configuration drift remediation, and secure decommissioning.

- Integrate macOS endpoint images and device configurations with VDI access requirements, security agents, logging agents, and authentication controls.

- Support passwordless authentication and hardware-backed credentials, where approved, for macOS users and privileged accounts.

- Configure and validate macOS logging and telemetry, including Unified Logs, endpoint agent reporting, and forwarding of relevant logs to SIEM/EDR platforms.

- Develop runbooks for macOS imaging, enrollment, patch validation, troubleshooting, and recovery.

- Assist with forensic collection support, audit readiness, and post-change validation for macOS endpoints.

- Provide technical guidance to the Engineer, Cloud Service Desk Representative, and company stakeholders on macOS endpoint architecture, security posture, and supportability.

Qualifications

CORE Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, or related field preferred; equivalent experience acceptable

- Must possess an active or interim Top Secret security clearance

- 8+ years of experience in IT, Endpoint Engineering, or Cybersecurity

- 6+ years of experience performing engineering functions in enterprise environments

- Experience working under formal change control, audit, and security governance processes

Additional Qualifications:

- Experience building and maintaining macOS workstation images

- Experience engineering secure macOS baseline configurations for remote and on-site users

- Experience integrating macOS endpoints with VDI clients, authentication agents, EDR/AV tools, and logging agents

- Experience validating image integrity and supporting image release, rollback, and testing

- Experience using JAMF Pro for macOS endpoint management

- Experience with Apple Business Manager for enrollment and provisioning workflows

- Experience managing macOS device enrollment, compliance, software deployment, and lifecycle operations

- Experience supporting FileVault/recovery key escrow, device wipe, reassignment, and decommissioning

- Experience configuring and supporting macOS Unified Logs

- Experience validating forwarding of macOS logs and telemetry to SIEM/EDR platforms

- Experience supporting secure authentication methods, including hardware-backed credentials where approved

- Experience with macOS compliance monitoring, baseline drift remediation, and audit support

jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

 Job Details

Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Endpoint Engineer to join our team. This role is primarily focused on Active Directory, Group Policy Management, and Intune policies as they relate to endpoints and users. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing endpoint engineering solutions in large-scale environments while ensuring seamless integration with organizational goals and user productivity. This position requires a proactive, self-motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment, managing multiple responsibilities, projects, and demands across various time zones with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

 Active Directory, Group Policy Management, and Intune Policy Engineering

- Design, implement, and manage Active Directory and Group Policies to support endpoint and user requirements across a global organization.

- Develop, implement, and optimize Intune policies tailored to endpoint and user management, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and compliance standards.

- Lead the transition of on-premises policies to cloud-based solutions, including Microsoft Intune , preparing for future migration to Microsoft Entra .

- Harmonize business requirements from application owners with endpoint policies to balance usability and security while maintaining operational excellence.

- Ensure endpoint policies are scalable and adaptable to meet the needs of a large, global organization with tens of thousands of users and endpoints.

Endpoint Engineering and Platform Management

- Manage and optimize management platforms, including but not limited to: Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM)Microsoft IntuneJamf (macOS management) NinjaOne (remote monitoring and management)

- Leverage Microsoft cloud-native technologies , including Microsoft Graph API , to streamline and automate endpoint management tasks.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex endpoint engineering issues across multiple platforms and operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.

- Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in endpoint engineering to continuously improve the organization’s endpoint strategy.

Collaboration and Cross-Functional Support

- Collaborate with infrastructure teams, application owners, and business stakeholders to implement endpoint solutions that meet organizational needs.

- Represent the user experience in cross-domain discussions, advocating for end-user productivity and minimizing disruption during policy changes.

- Work closely with security teams to address ad-hoc requests, ensuring endpoint solutions align with security goals while prioritizing usability.

- Act as a liaison between infrastructure and security teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment on endpoint-related initiatives.

Security and Hardening Support

- Field security-related requests and collaborate with security teams to ensure endpoint policies adhere to CIS (Center for Internet Security) Levels 1 & 2 benchmarks.

- Provide guidance on endpoint hardening practices, ensuring systems are secure, resilient, and compliant while prioritizing the user experience.

- Participate in security meetings as needed, offering technical expertise and insights into endpoint engineering strategies.

Leadership and Communication

- Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in Active Directory , Group Policy , and Intune policies , providing mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.

- Translate technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment across various levels of the organization.

- Drive strategic initiatives related to endpoint management, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and priorities.

Required Qualifications

- 20+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, with a primary focus on Active Directory , Group Policy Management , and Intune policies as they relate to endpoints and users.

- Proven expertise in managing endpoint platforms such as MECM, Intune, Jamf, NinjaOne, and other similar tools.

- Demonstrated ability to transition on-premises policies to cloud-based solutions, particularly Intune, and prepare for Microsoft Entra migrations.

- Experience with Microsoft cloud-native technologies , including Microsoft Graph API , Azure Active Directory , and related tools for endpoint management and automation.

- Exceptional troubleshooting skills across endpoint engineering platforms, operating systems, and user domains.

- Experience navigating large global organizations with tens of thousands of users and endpoints, including integrated and non-integrated entities.

-
 Self-starter with a proactive mindset , capable of managing multiple responsibilities, projects, and demands in a highly dynamic global environment across multiple time zones.

- Ability to work independently with minimal oversight, driving initiatives forward while maintaining accountability and focus.

- Strong collaboration skills to engage effectively across domains and organizational levels, ensuring alignment between infrastructure, security, and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in enterprise-scale environments with complex endpoint requirements.

- Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or similar.

- Strong familiarity with Microsoft Entra and its integration into endpoint and identity management strategies.

Key Competencies

-
 Technical Expertise : Deep understanding of Active Directory , Group Policy , Intune policies , and endpoint engineering platforms.

-
 Self-Motivation and Independence : Ability to work autonomously, managing competing priorities and navigating complex global environments with confidence and efficiency.

-
 User-Centric Approach : Ability to prioritize user experience and productivity in policy design and implementation.

-
 Problem-Solving : Proficiency in identifying and resolving complex endpoint engineering issues.

-
 Collaboration : Strong ability to work across teams and domains, fostering partnerships between infrastructure, security, and business units.

-
 Communication : Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and advocate for user experience in cross-functional discussions.

   What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. jobs.description:
About the RoleSophos is seeking a Global Solutions Engineer to provide senior technical leadership across two strategic growth areas: our Managed Security Service Provider program and our expanding portfolio of AI security solutions.

About the Role

 Sophos is seeking a Global Solutions Engineer to provide senior technical leadership across two strategic growth areas: our Managed Security Service Provider program and our expanding portfolio of AI security solutions. This is a highly visible individual contributor role for someone who can combine deep cybersecurity expertise, hands-on technical capability, partner engagement, and strong business acumen.

In this role, you will help MSSP partners design, launch, and scale differentiated managed security services powered by Sophos technologies. You will also serve as a global subject matter expert for Sophos AI security solutions, helping customers and partners understand, evaluate, and secure the use of AI across modern environments.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable leading executive-level technical conversations, advising SOC and security engineering teams, building labs and demonstrations, supporting proofs of value, and translating complex cybersecurity and AI concepts into clear business outcomes.

What You Will Do

MSSP Program Technical Leadership

- Serve as the primary Solutions Engineer for Sophos ’ global MSSP program and strategic partner opportunities.

- Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture workshops, demonstrations, and proofs of value with MSSP partners.

- Help partners design and scale managed security services using Sophos Fusion and the broader Sophos cybersecurity portfolio.

- Advise partners on service architecture, integrations, automation, operational readiness, and repeatable service delivery.

AI Security Domain Leadership

- Act as a global subject matter expert for Sophos AI security solutions, including AI Defense and future AI offerings.

- Lead demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of value that help customers and partners evaluate AI security risks and solutions.

- Build hands-on AI security demos, lab environments, attack simulations, and repeatable technical evaluation methods.

- Share field and market insights with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams.

Global Leadership and Field Impact

- Create reusable technical assets, enablement materials, service blueprints, and field-ready best practices.

- Mentor Sales Engineers, partner engineers, and other technical stakeholders to strengthen global field capability.

- Represent Sophos in customer briefings, partner events, webinars, technical communities, and industry forums.

- Build trusted-advisor relationships with partners, customers, security leaders, and technical decision-makers.

What You Will Bring

- 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Security Architecture, security consulting, MSSP engineering, or a similar customer-facing cybersecurity role.

- Experience supporting MSSP sales, partner engagements, service architecture, or managed security service development.

- Strong knowledge of modern security operations, including MDR, XDR, SIEM, SOAR, endpoint security, cloud security, threat detection, incident response, and security integrations.

- Deep understanding of MSSP business and technical models, including the requirements for delivering repeatable services to multiple customers.

- Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI systems, AI application architectures, and the security risks associated with adopting and operating AI technologies.

- Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, integrating, operating, and troubleshooting cybersecurity products and tools.

- Experience building labs, demonstrations, workshops, proofs of value, and technical validation environments.

- Ability to work with APIs, automation, cloud platforms, modern application architectures, Linux and Windows environments, networking, identity systems, and security telemetry.

- Exceptional technical discovery, consultative selling, presentation, storytelling, demonstration, and written communication skills.

- Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional technical engagements with partners, customers, and internal teams across multiple regions.

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% across North America and internationally.

Nice to Have

- Direct experience working in a Security Operations Center, security engineering organization, incident response team, or cybersecurity leadership role.

- Experience designing, operating, or bringing managed security services to market.

- Experience with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or similar tools.

- Familiarity with cloud AI platforms, AI agents, model APIs, local or private models, open-source AI technologies, containers, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps practices.

- Experience speaking at industry events, publishing technical content, or representing an organization as a cybersecurity subject matter expert.

- Relevant cybersecurity, cloud, architecture, or AI certifications.

- Experience with Sophos technologies.

Why Sophos

 Sophos helps organizations and service providers reduce cyber risk through an integrated portfolio of cybersecurity technologies, managed security services, threat intelligence, and expert-led security operations.

As a Global Solutions Engineer, you will help shape how MSSPs build the next generation of managed security services while contributing to emerging AI security solutions that help customers and partners adopt AI securely. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on engineering, strategic partner engagement, product influence, public thought leadership, and global field impact in a role with meaningful visibility and scope.

In Canada, the base salary for this role ranges from $142,100 to $236,600. In addition to the base salary, there's a component for target sales commissions alongside a comprehensive benefits package. A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

What this Job Entails:

The Systems Engineer II provides remote technical support for endpoint

engineering, Microsoft 365 administration, and identity lifecycle

management, extending coverage for a broader IT team responsible for

end-user computing infrastructure, including hardware, software, mobile

device management, and system architecture. This role works 8x5 with

overlap into US business hours to ensure continuity with the onsite team.

Scope:

- Applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues

- Works on problems of moderate scope

- Receives general instructions on routine work and detailed instructions on new projects

Your Roles and Responsibilities:

- Provide remote 8x5 coverage (with morning overlap into US business hours) for endpoint engineering, M365 administration, and identity lifecycle tasks

- Handle remote-resolvable Level 2 tasks: complex OS and application troubleshooting, endpoint policy enforcement, and MDM configuration (Intune, Jamf)

- Support AD/Entra ID user, group, and access provisioning as part of joiner-mover-leaver (JML) identity workflows

- Contribute to automation initiatives that reduce manual, repetitive engineering tasks

- Able to work under project deadlines and associated cost and schedule constraints

- Comfortable working a shift with overlap into US business hours

Preferred Qualifications:

- MD-102 (Modern Desktop Administrator), MS-700 (Teams Administrator), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), or SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator)

- - Experience in regulated (GxP, financial services, or life sciences) environments, including change management for validated systems

Physical Demand & Work Environment:

- Some positions may require occasional repetitive motion or movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers

jobs.description:
Who we are. Platinum Technologies is a Northern Virginia based integrated solutions firm that specializes in PaaS, Cybersecurity & AI Platform development for the Defense and Federal Sectors.

Who we are.

 Platinum Technologies is a Northern Virginia based integrated solutions firm that specializes in PaaS, Cybersecurity & AI Platform development for the Defense and Federal Sectors. Our team solves hard problems and helps our Mission Partners achieve their goals. If you are self-motivated, possess demonstrated learning agility, and are passionate about delivering high-quality work products – we want to hear from you.

We lead with technical expertise, but that is just the tip of the iceberg – the ‘Why’ matters. At Platinum, we don’t hire people to just do a job. We provide professional and leadership development to complement our self-motivated domain experts. Our teammates are dot-connecting leaders that operate in a mutually accountable environment to deliver thought leadership, expert technical analysis, and quality execution for our clients.

You.

 Platinum Technologies is seeking an experienced Senior Endpoint Support Engineer with a with Azure/Intune/SCCM background to provide advanced technical support and operational expertise in support of enterprise endpoint migration initiatives. This role will serve as a senior escalation point for complex endpoint issues and will partner closely with Endpoint Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Service Desk teams to ensure successful migration activities and a stable end-user experience.

The ideal candidate will have strong troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, enterprise applications, identity, networking, device management, and endpoint security, along with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues that cannot be addressed through standard Tier 1/Tier 2 support processes.

This role is REMOTE .

* Candidates must hold an active Secret clearance.*

What you get to do.

- Provide Tier 3 technical support for issues associated with endpoint migration, deployment, provisioning, and post-migration stabilization.

- Troubleshoot complex Windows endpoint issues involving operating systems, drivers, applications, profiles, authentication, networking, peripherals, and device configuration.

- Support endpoint migration activities including device replacement, operating system upgrades, hardware refreshes, profile/data migration, application deployment, and user cutover.

- Investigate and resolve migration failures, deployment errors, application compatibility issues, configuration problems, and recurring endpoint incidents.

- Serve as the escalation point for Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk teams and provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer.

- Partner with Endpoint Engineering and other technical teams to identify root causes and develop sustainable remediation strategies.

- Support endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Autopilot, or comparable enterprise management technologies.

- Troubleshoot Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, authentication, VPN, printing, and other business-critical endpoint services

- Assist with endpoint security controls, including device compliance, encryption, endpoint protection, and security policy troubleshooting.

- Develop and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures, and migration runbooks.

- Analyze incident and migration data to identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for automation or process improvement.

- Participate in migration waves, cutovers, hypercare, and other scheduled deployment activities, including occasional after-hours support when required.

- Coordinate with vendors and third-party support organizations when escalation outside the internal environment is necessary.

- Ensure incidents and service requests are accurately documented and resolved in accordance with established service management processes.

- Candidates must hold an active Secret Clearance

Required Skills.

- Requires High School Diploma or equivalent and 2+ years of prior relevant experience

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise IT support, desktop engineering, endpoint management, or service desk operations.

- Azure/Intune/SCCM background

- Demonstrated experience providing Tier 3 / advanced technical support in a large enterprise environment.

- Strong troubleshooting experience with Windows 10/11 endpoints and Microsoft 365.

- Hands-on experience with endpoint management and deployment technologies such as Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, Autopilot, Group Policy, and Active Directory/Entra ID.

- Experience supporting enterprise endpoint migrations, hardware refreshes, operating system upgrades, or large-scale device deployments.

- Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, Wi-Fi, and authentication.

- Experience troubleshooting endpoint applications, drivers, peripherals, certificates, profiles, and system configuration.

- Ability to analyze logs and system information to isolate complex technical issues.

- Strong incident management, problem management, and root-cause analysis skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical teams.

- Must maintain and be 8570 compliant.

Desired Qualifications.

- Experience supporting large-scale Windows 11 migrations or enterprise device modernization programs.

- Experience with Microsoft Autopilot and modern endpoint management.

- Experience with PowerShell scripting and endpoint automation.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, and endpoint compliance.

- ITIL certification or experience working within an ITIL-based service management environment.

- Microsoft certifications related to endpoint administration, Microsoft 365, or Azure.

- Experience working in a project-based migration or transformation environment

 The Company is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, race, color, religious creed, national origin, citizenship, marital status, sex, sexual orientation/gender identity, age, or genetic information.

jobs.description:
### About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

### **About the Role**

We’re hiring an IT Systems Engineer to help build, secure, and improve the systems our employees rely on every day, with a particular focus on identity and access management (IAM) and mobile device management (MDM).

You’ll share ownership with our IT and Security engineers to improve how we manage identities, application access, and devices. This is a hands-on role that combines technical configuration, security judgment, and automation. We’re looking for someone who uses AI effectively to troubleshoot, build, and improve IT workflows. Experience managing IT systems as code using Terraform is a strong plus.

This role requires in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday from one of our offices (SF, NY, or ATX). For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

### **What You Will Do**

- Configure and improve Okta, including application integrations, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), groups, access policies, and automated provisioning.
- Build reliable onboarding, role-change, and offboarding workflows that keep employee access appropriate and up to date.
- Configure and maintain MDM solutions, including device enrollment, configuration profiles, software deployment, patching, encryption, and compliance controls.
- Partner with Security to define and implement least-privilege access, device security standards, access reviews, and device-based access policies.
- Design and maintain scripts, API integrations, and automation across Okta, MDM, Google Workspace, Slack, and IT service management systems.
- Help expand management of IT systems through code, including opportunities to use Terraform for Okta configuration and other supported resources.
- Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and workflow improvements while validating outputs and protecting company data.
- Serve as an escalation point for complex identity, device, and systems issues; address root causes and prevent recurring problems.
- Support AWS identity and access configurations as part of the broader IT environment.
- Maintain clear documentation for configurations, access policies, integrations, and operational procedures.
- Identify opportunities to simplify the IT environment, reduce technical debt, and improve SaaS lifecycle processes.

### **About You**

- Strong hands-on IT systems engineering experience, with deep expertise in either IAM or MDM and solid working knowledge of the other.
- Experience administering Okta and integrating applications using technologies such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM.
- Experience configuring and operating an MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Intune, or an equivalent.
- Strong understanding of security principles, including least privilege, authentication and authorization, endpoint hardening, and secure handling of credentials and company data.
- Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python or Bash, APIs, and workflow automation tools.
- Demonstrated experience using AI to solve technical problems and improve IT operations, with the judgment to review generated code and validate proposed changes.
- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to follow problems across identity, devices, applications, and integrations.
- Comfortable sharing ownership, collaborating with Security and other teams, and explaining technical decisions clearly.
- Able to take projects from identifying a problem through implementation, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

### **A Strong Plus**

- Experience using Terraform to manage Okta or other IT systems as code, including version-controlled configurations, code review, repeatable deployments, and configuration drift management.

### **Success in This Role Looks Like**

- More reliable identity lifecycle workflows, with timely provisioning, access changes, and deprovisioning.
- Better device enrollment, patching, and compliance through consistent MDM configurations and automation.
- Clearer access policies and repeatable access reviews developed in partnership with Security.
- Less manual work through maintainable automation and effective use of AI.
- More consistent, reviewable system configurations through expanded use of code where appropriate.
- Fewer recurring identity and device issues through root-cause fixes.
- Reliable documentation that helps the team operate, troubleshoot, and improve shared systems.

### **Benefits**

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
- Generous paid time off and parental leave
- Professional development stipend
- Daily lunch and commuter benefits (SF office)

### Compensation & Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.
- Inclusive Healthcare Package.
- Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
- Flexible Time Off.
- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $180,000.00 - $288,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

- **Equal Opportunity:** Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. About the RoleSophos is seeking a Global Solutions Engineer to provide senior technical leadership across two strategic growth areas: our Managed Security Service Provider program and our expanding portfolio of AI security solutions.

About the Role

 Sophos is seeking a Global Solutions Engineer to provide senior technical leadership across two strategic growth areas: our Managed Security Service Provider program and our expanding portfolio of AI security solutions. This is a highly visible individual contributor role for someone who can combine deep cybersecurity expertise, hands-on technical capability, partner engagement, and strong business acumen.

In this role, you will help MSSP partners design, launch, and scale differentiated managed security services powered by Sophos technologies. You will also serve as a global subject matter expert for Sophos AI security solutions, helping customers and partners understand, evaluate, and secure the use of AI across modern environments.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable leading executive-level technical conversations, advising SOC and security engineering teams, building labs and demonstrations, supporting proofs of value, and translating complex cybersecurity and AI concepts into clear business outcomes.

What You Will Do

MSSP Program Technical Leadership

- Serve as the primary Solutions Engineer for Sophos ’ global MSSP program and strategic partner opportunities.

- Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture workshops, demonstrations, and proofs of value with MSSP partners.

- Help partners design and scale managed security services using Sophos Fusion and the broader Sophos cybersecurity portfolio.

- Advise partners on service architecture, integrations, automation, operational readiness, and repeatable service delivery.

AI Security Domain Leadership

- Act as a global subject matter expert for Sophos AI security solutions, including AI Defense and future AI offerings.

- Lead demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of value that help customers and partners evaluate AI security risks and solutions.

- Build hands-on AI security demos, lab environments, attack simulations, and repeatable technical evaluation methods.

- Share field and market insights with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams.

Global Leadership and Field Impact

- Create reusable technical assets, enablement materials, service blueprints, and field-ready best practices.

- Mentor Sales Engineers, partner engineers, and other technical stakeholders to strengthen global field capability.

- Represent Sophos in customer briefings, partner events, webinars, technical communities, and industry forums.

- Build trusted-advisor relationships with partners, customers, security leaders, and technical decision-makers.

What You Will Bring

- 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Security Architecture, security consulting, MSSP engineering, or a similar customer-facing cybersecurity role.

- Experience supporting MSSP sales, partner engagements, service architecture, or managed security service development.

- Strong knowledge of modern security operations, including MDR, XDR, SIEM, SOAR, endpoint security, cloud security, threat detection, incident response, and security integrations.

- Deep understanding of MSSP business and technical models, including the requirements for delivering repeatable services to multiple customers.

- Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI systems, AI application architectures, and the security risks associated with adopting and operating AI technologies.

- Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, integrating, operating, and troubleshooting cybersecurity products and tools.

- Experience building labs, demonstrations, workshops, proofs of value, and technical validation environments.

- Ability to work with APIs, automation, cloud platforms, modern application architectures, Linux and Windows environments, networking, identity systems, and security telemetry.

- Exceptional technical discovery, consultative selling, presentation, storytelling, demonstration, and written communication skills.

- Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional technical engagements with partners, customers, and internal teams across multiple regions.

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% across North America and internationally.

Nice to Have

- Direct experience working in a Security Operations Center, security engineering organization, incident response team, or cybersecurity leadership role.

- Experience designing, operating, or bringing managed security services to market.

- Experience with scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or similar tools.

- Familiarity with cloud AI platforms, AI agents, model APIs, local or private models, open-source AI technologies, containers, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps practices.

- Experience speaking at industry events, publishing technical content, or representing an organization as a cybersecurity subject matter expert.

- Relevant cybersecurity, cloud, architecture, or AI certifications.

- Experience with Sophos technologies.

Why Sophos

 Sophos helps organizations and service providers reduce cyber risk through an integrated portfolio of cybersecurity technologies, managed security services, threat intelligence, and expert-led security operations.

As a Global Solutions Engineer, you will help shape how MSSPs build the next generation of managed security services while contributing to emerging AI security solutions that help customers and partners adopt AI securely. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on engineering, strategic partner engagement, product influence, public thought leadership, and global field impact in a role with meaningful visibility and scope.

In addition to the base salary, there's a component for target sales commissions alongside a comprehensive benefits package. A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, VIRTUALIZATION & STORAGE

 As an IT Infrastructure Engineer on the infrastructure team, you will collaborate with internal teams to deliver innovative solutions for SpaceX’s growing infrastructure demands. You will ensure quality and reliability of systems across the software lifecycle while scaling and supporting data center infrastructure, virtualization, Kubernetes, and storage environments. You should have strong opinions on designing, testing, and operating virtualization platforms and multi-tier storage (enterprise + HPC) and be ready to build the next generation of SpaceX data center platforms.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Implement and maintain a scalable, robust VMware environment and identify efficiencies supporting critical applications

- Design, implement, and maintain storage infrastructure across high-performance, capacity, archive, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery tiers

- Architect and operate high-throughput, low-latency storage and support exabyte scale file systems (e.g., VAST,) for simulation, telemetry, and high-concurrency workloads

- Administer enterprise storage platforms (NetApp, Pure FlashArray/FlashBlade, Cohesity, Scality) and manage access controls, permissions, and protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI)

- Collaborate with compute, networking, and application teams to align virtualization and storage strategies with workload requirements

- Participate in on-call rotation, scheduled maintenance, and occasional physical installation support

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering or related technical field and 3+ years of engineering experience in an enterprise environment; OR 5+ years of engineering experience in lieu of a degree

- 1+ years of professional experience managing virtualized server environments

- 5+ years of experience in IT storage engineering with enterprise platforms (NetApp, Pure Storage, Scality, Vast or similar)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience with full lifecycle management of large-scale VMware environments and supporting container infrastructure with Kubernetes

- Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tools

- Deep knowledge of RDMA, congestion control, lossless Ethernet, RoCEv2, and/or InfiniBand storage fabrics in HPC or latency-sensitive environments

- Experience automating infrastructure with Python, PowerShell, or Ansible

- Familiarity with HPC schedulers (Slurm, LFS) and how storage tiers interact with job scheduling

- Linux and Windows OS system administration experience

- Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills; strong written and verbal communication

jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

### Responsibilities

- Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
- Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
- Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
- Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
- Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
- Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
- Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
- Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

### You may be a good fit if you

- Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
- Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
- Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
- Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
- Write Python and shell scripts
- Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

### Strong candidates may also have

- Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
- Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
- Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
- Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
- Have used LLMs to automate ops work

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$285,000—$325,000 USD

### **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

jobs.summary: **Senior Systems Administrator** At Forge, we bring together a global portfolio of market-leading businesses and specialist teams, connected by the technology and systems that help them do their best work. We’re collaborative, ambitious, and always...
jobs.description:
**Senior Systems Administrator**

At Forge, we bring together a global portfolio of market-leading businesses and specialist teams, connected by the technology and systems that help them do their best work. We’re collaborative, ambitious, and always looking for smarter ways to build, improve and grow.

We’re looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to join our UK team, based in Shepherd’s Bush, London. We’re looking for someone experienced, proactive, and excited about taking ownership of a world-class tech environment and helping shape how it grows.

This is a role that requires a critical onsite presence within one of our UK businesses, This is Beyond, and complements our expert US-based Forge IT team. You’ll be based at the This is Beyond office but report into an IT leader at Forge, working closely across our systems and teams. It’s a hybrid, cross-functional role with real ownership across our UK and South Africa IT environment, especially suited to someone who loves improving systems, automating, and connecting the dots.

**Who You Are**

To be successful in this role you'll be curious, calm under pressure, and love helping people solve tech problems from "my Wi-Fi won’t connect" to "can you help me automate this system-wide rollout." You’ll be great at managing your own time, jumping between Mac and Windows, and be looking for more than just reactive ticketing, you'll want to contribute to big-picture improvements and proactive support.

You will need to be comfortable taking ownership and working independently in an onsite environment, while knowing when to ask questions and loop in your wider team. You’ll be confident making recommendations, identifying improvements and bringing your own experience and ideas to the wider Forge IT team. You get excited by new tools, big transitions, and smart solutions, and still want to keep learning as the business grows.

**What You’ll Do**

- Set up and support employee workstations and infrastructure in a cross-functional and hybrid office environment

- Deploy and support company laptops (both Windows and Mac OS)

- Administer, maintain, and continuously improve Office365, Entra ID and Azure environments for our UK and EU-based users

- Deploy security patches, application patches, configuration changes, and registry updates using RMM/MDM tools to endpoints

- Take ownership of endpoint security, patching and appropriate security controls to help protect the organisation’s data and infrastructure

- Participate in the change management process and support systems, infrastructure, migration and rollout projects

- Carry out daily administrative tasks, reporting, and communication with relevant departments

- Maintain antivirus software and ensure coverage across networks

- Own and resolve service desk tickets end-to-end with efficiency and clarity, escalating to the wider Forge IT team where appropriate

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative tasks and processes (PowerShell a plus).

- Lead or play important role in IT systems integration in all current and future acquisition

**What You’ll Need:**

- Proven experience in a Senior Systems Administrator, Senior Systems Engineer or similar role, with the confidence to independently own an IT environment

- Experience supporting both Windows and Mac OS

- Confidence working with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)

- Strong working knowledge of Office365, Active Directory and Entra ID

- Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace.

- Hands-on knowledge of patch management, antivirus, and endpoint detection

- Experience with MDM/RMM tools and virtualisation

- Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical issues and manage service tickets end-to-end

- Bonus points for PowerShell scripting, network knowledge and experience working with third-party IT suppliers or vendors

- Experience supporting systems through acquisitions, mergers or business integrations

- Strong understanding of security stack (Crowdstrike, Wazuh, Defender, etc)

**How This Role Is Structured**

- You’ll be based onsite in our Shepherd’s Bush office four days a week (Monday to Thursday), with Friday working from home. You’ll need to be flexible to attend the Shepherd’s Bush office or another London location on a Friday if IT or business needs require onsite support.

- You’ll report directly into a US-based IT manager within Forge’s wider team

- You’ll have daily check-ins with the broader Forge IT team and full support behind you

- You will also take ownership of day-to-day IT across our UK and South Africa entities, working closely with the wider Forge IT team to keep systems, infrastructure, security and support running smoothly.

**Why Us?**

As part of Forge, you’ll have access to advanced tools, career pathways, smart colleagues, and a wider global team to learn from and collaborate with.

We believe in thoughtful work and keep standards high - from the way we launch an event to how we reset a router. You’ll get the best of both worlds: a close-knit team culture onsite, and access to a global IT operation that’s growing, learning, and building better systems every day.

**Benefits:** Enjoy a range of benefits, including: Pension Scheme, Hybrid working arrangement, Private Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, 30 days annual leave per year.

**Position Type:** Permanent, 5 day working week. 4 days based in our Shepherd’s Bush office, with Friday working from home. Flexibility to attend the office on Fridays will be required if IT or business needs arise.

**Diversity & Inclusion:** At Forge, we're dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on factors such as race, colour, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic.

**How to Apply:** Ready to join our team? Explore our available career opportunities and discover how you can contribute to our journey.

jobs.description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity:**

As an experienced, entrepreneurial Solutions Specialist, you will serve as the principal technical authority in modernizing enterprise and desktop solutions across hybrid multi-cloud environments. You will architect, validate, and execute high-availability desktop solutions centered on Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) hybrid and public cloud bare-metal infrastructure.

Acting as a trusted advisor to enterprise CIOs, CTOs, and Cloud Directors, you will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure engineering and end-user experience to deliver secure, scalable, and cost-optimized ecosystems.

**About the Team:**

The successful candidate will join the EMEA Solution Specialists & Systems Engineering Organization at Nutanix—a forward-thinking group dedicated to solving complex enterprise infrastructure, cloud, and AI workload challenges. We are part of a mature, financially viable cloud software company that prides itself on bringing radical simplicity to complex technology.

In this role, you will report to the Manager, Systems Engineering. The position is fully remote within the EMEA region, offering high flexibility, but requires the ability to travel up to 25% including dedicated time doing customer discovery, architectural workshops, executive briefings, and partner collaboration across EMEA.

**Your Role:**

As Solutions Specialist, you will act as a primary technical deal architect and domain expert, driving pre-sales architecture, technical discovery, proof-of-concept (POC) validations, and enterprise cloud and desktop modernization strategies.

Domain Leadership & Enablement: Maintain authoritative, deep-dive expertise across multiple Nutanix products like EUC, Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2), and the broader ecosystem. Deliver cross-functional knowledge transfer to regional SEs, sales teams, and channel partners.

Technical Validation & Demonstrations: Lead advanced technical product presentations, live demonstrations, hands-on Proof of Concepts (POCs), and technical feasibility assessments for enterprise prospects.

Strategic Discovery & Qualification: Drive deep technical discovery and qualify opportunities for emerging technologies and enterprise cloud and desktop modernization across enterprise, federal, and commercial accounts.

Cross-Domain Solution Pairing: Collaborate closely with specialists across Nutanix Enterprise AI (NAI), Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), and External Storage to deliver full-stack solution architectures.

Opportunity Expansion & Field Feedback: Identify portfolio expansion opportunities within installed accounts, synthesize customer feedback, and partner directly with Nutanix Product Management and Engineering to influence the product roadmap.

Workload Migration: Formulate zero-downtime migration paths for enterprise desktop workloads into modern cloud desktop architectures.

Disaster Recovery (DR): Establish automated disaster recovery strategies via Nutanix Disaster Recovery and advanced cloud bursting methods.

Storage & Profile Management: Implement enterprise profile management strategies utilizing FSLogix, scalable file/block storage platforms, and Nutanix Unified Storage (NUS).

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop automated deployment templates using Terraform, PowerShell, and REST APIs to streamline NC2 cluster provisioning, host pool scaling, and image management.

Performance Validation: Lead technical discovery, capacity sizing, and performance validation utilizing NVIDIA vGPU / RTX vWS acceleration to guarantee an optimal user experience globally.

Cloud Desktop Architecture: Design scalable, high-availability virtual desktop solutions (AVD and hybrid desktop pools) bridging on-premises data centers and public cloud bare-metal environments (Azure & AWS).

Multi-Cloud Integration: Design cross-cloud network topologies, routing, and identity frameworks connecting desktop host pools with enterprise back-end application stacks.

Ecosystem Alignment: Collaborate with Microsoft Azure and AWS technical field teams to align cloud desktop deployments with enterprise consumption agreements and marketplace commitments.

**Technical & Architectural Experience**

Enterprise Architecture: Deep, proven experience in enterprise pre-sales systems engineering, cloud consulting, or infrastructure architecture specializing in public cloud VDI design.

Cloud Desktop Mastery: Advanced, hands-on architectural experience with Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) in hybrid and pure-cloud models.

Core Systems Control: Expert-level command of Microsoft FSLogix (Profile Containers, App Attach), Entra ID, conditional access, and zero-trust security architecture.

Software-Defined Infrastructure: Strong experience extending infrastructure to public clouds via Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2 on Azure/AWS), Nutanix Unified Storage (NUS), AOS, AHV, and Prism Central.

**Field & Pre-Sales Capability**

Experience: 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing pre-sales technical role (Solutions Architect, Systems Engineer, or Specialist Architect) within an enterprise software, cloud, or infrastructure organization. Prior experience in high-performance computing (HPC) or graphic-intensive VDI environments.

Consultative Selling: Proven track record of leading architectural design workshops, executing successful POCs, answering RFIs/RFPs, and handling complex technical objections from DBAs, Infrastructure Architects, and CXOs.

Business Acumen: Ability to articulate enterprise cloud and desktop TCO, licensing savings, operational efficiency gains, and risk reduction to senior IT leadership.

**Soft Skills & Operational Requirements**

Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills; able to translate intricate enterprise cloud and desktop engineering concepts into clear business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience / industry certifications (e.g., Nutanix NCP/NCA, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, Oracle OCP, or Microsoft SQL/PostgreSQL certifications).

Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% across the EMEA region as required for customer engagements, team offsites, and industry events.

jobs.description:
About the Role
As a SCCM & Intune Migration Engineer, you will make an impact by driving enterprise endpoint modernization initiatives and leading the migration from traditional Microsoft SCCM/MECM environments to Microsoft Intune and cloud-based endpoint management solutions. You will be responsible for assessing current-state infrastructure, designing migration strategies, implementing co-management and cloud-native device management, and supporting large-scale device transformation programs. You will collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Azure, Active Directory/Entra ID, Networking, Service Desk, Desktop Engineering, and Application teams to deliver secure, scalable, and modern endpoint management services.

In this role, you will

Assess existing SCCM/MECM environments, including infrastructure, device management, application deployment, software updates, compliance policies, security controls, and operational processes.Develop and execute the migration strategy and roadmap for transitioning from SCCM/MECM to Microsoft Intune and cloud-based endpoint management.Design the target-state endpoint management architecture leveraging Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, and related Microsoft cloud technologies.Configure and manage SCCM-Intune Co-management and oversee the transition of endpoint management workloads from SCCM to Intune.Lead the migration of device configurations, compliance policies, security baselines, applications, scripts, software updates, and endpoint security controls to Intune.Implement Microsoft Entra ID Join/Hybrid Join and Windows Autopilot solutions to support modern device provisioning and lifecycle management.Perform application compatibility assessments and develop remediation strategies for applications requiring modernization or repackaging.Plan and execute pilot deployments, migration waves, and phased device migrations while minimizing business disruption and operational risk.Establish migration governance, standards, risk management processes, and success metrics to support enterprise migration objectives.Develop KPI reporting, migration dashboards, and executive-level status reporting to track migration progress, compliance, risks, and operational readiness.Create architecture documentation, solution designs, runbooks, SOPs, migration procedures, rollback plans, and operational handover materials.Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Azure, Network, Service Desk, Desktop Engineering, and Application teams throughout the migration lifecycle.Lead knowledge transfer, post-migration hypercare, operational stabilization, and transition activities for support teams.Develop and execute SCCM infrastructure rationalization and decommissioning plans following successful migration completion.Work model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in Raritan, NJ. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What you need to have to be considered

8+ years of experience in enterprise endpoint management and workplace technology environments.Strong expertise with Microsoft SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, and SCCM-Intune Co-management.Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Hybrid Join, Conditional Access, and Azure services.Experience architecting and implementing Windows Autopilot and modern endpoint management solutions.Strong PowerShell scripting, automation, and troubleshooting skills.Experience with application packaging, deployment, software distribution, and patch management.Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, endpoint security, compliance, and Zero Trust principles.Experience leading large-scale SCCM-to-Intune migration or endpoint modernization initiatives.Strong communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and solution design skills.These will help you stand out

Experience designing enterprise-scale endpoint management and Modern Workplace architectures.Experience developing migration factories, governance frameworks, and migration wave strategies.Experience with KPI reporting, executive communications, hypercare management, and operational transformation.Experience decommissioning legacy SCCM environments following cloud migration initiatives.Microsoft certifications in Intune, Endpoint Administration, Azure, Microsoft 365, or Security.We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out.

Applications will be accepted until October 15, 2026.
The annual salary for this position is between $100,000 - $115,000 USD depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

jobs.description:
Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

 AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms.

Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026. Position Summary As a Data Management Engineer III with Commercial Master Data Management (MDM) expertise you will help clients strengthen commercial data foundations that power trusted analytics, omnichannel engagement, and compliant commercial operations. This role is hands-on with Reltio MDM and/or Informatica MDM (including Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) and Data Quality (DQ) capabilities, as applicable) and will focus on key Life Sciences commercial domains including HCP/HCO, affiliations, hierarchies (e.g., Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs)/health systems), territories and alignment, product masters/hierarchies, and reference data.

Help design and run capabilities that produce high-quality golden records, enable effective stewardship, and support consistent syndication of mastered data to downstream platforms (e.g., lakehouse, customer relationship management (CRM), and analytics). Work you'll do

 Serve as an MDM product and delivery lead, defining roadmaps, backlogs, governance, and operating models for commercial master data. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and IT) to align priorities and drive adoption. Facilitate the design and maintain MDM data models and hierarchies for HCP/HCO, accounts, affiliations, IDN/health system structures, customer alignment/territories (including effective dating), product hierarchies, and reference data. Configure and optimize identity resolution (match/merge), survivorship, and stewardship workflows to reduce duplicates and improve match confidence, including explainable outcomes and controlled exception handling. Establish and manage identifier strategies and crosswalks across internal systems (e.g., CRM, data lake) and third-party identifiers, ensuring lineage and auditability. Define data quality rules, thresholds, monitoring, and remediation processes; implement profiling, exception queues, and issue management with clear service level agreements (SLAs) and ownership. Contribute to standing up and running stewardship and governance operations (roles, routines, queue management), including change control and audit-ready documentation. Support privacy-aware design, access controls, and compliance requirements in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Information Security. Drive operational excellence through runbooks, release and environment promotion practices, incident/problem management, and performance monitoring. Explore practical human-in-the-loop automation for stewardship (e.g., suggested merges, remediation workflows with approvals) and natural-language search over stewardship cases/lineage, aligned to enterprise controls.
 The team Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively. Qualifications Required

5+ years of experience in data management / MDM, including significant experience in Life Sciences commercial data 2+ years of hands-on implementation and/or operations experience with Reltio MDM and/or Informatica MDM 2+ years demonstrated knowledge of Life Sciences commercial domains (HCP/HCO, affiliations, territories/alignment, CRM, product hierarchies, account structures) 4+ years experience designing and operating data governance and stewardship models, including KPI definition and reporting 4+ years experience with data integration patterns (batch and streaming), APIs, and data pipelines 4+ years experience with data quality tooling and operational monitoring Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
 Preferred
 Experience with Veeva CRM and Life Sciences commercial data vendors/ecosystems Experience with complex affiliation and hierarchy modeling (e.g., time-variant affiliations, multiple hierarchy types) Experience operating MDM in a product model (roadmaps, SLAs, release trains, adoption)
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets;

experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,200 to $229,100. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.summary: #### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is...
jobs.description:
#### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

#### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We're looking for an Endpoint Engineer to own how every laptop, phone, and piece of office technology at Panthalassa is deployed, secured, and kept healthy. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role sitting alongside our IT Support function. You'll lead the initiatives that let us scale device management without scaling headcount: zero touch deployment for Windows and macOS, BYOD support for mobile devices, endpoint security baselines, and the device compliance posture our access policies depend on. You'll also serve as an escalation point and mentor for our IT Support Specialists, and act as our subject matter expert in physical office technology, from access control to printers to patch panels.

Our IT Support team runs the day to day of the physical office: badge issuance, printer break/fix, conference room checks, and desk moves. You own the design, standards, and escalations behind all of it, and you get your hands dirty on build-outs and the hard problems. One day you're writing configuration profiles to automate workstation security, the next you're installing A/V equipment and running patch cables.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

#### **Responsibilities**

##### **Endpoint Management and Zero Touch Deployment**

- Administer our MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune, JumpCloud) for Windows and macOS devices, including enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery.
- Architect and execute our zero touch provisioning rollout (Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager / Automatic Device Enrollment), eliminating manual imaging for new device deployments.
- Drive device enrollment to full coverage and keep it there through regular audit.
- Design and implement BYOD policies and enrollment workflows that enable secure access from personal devices.
- Own the device lifecycle: procurement standards, refresh cadence, repair, and secure decommissioning.

##### **Endpoint Security and Compliance**

- Build and enforce endpoint security baselines, patch management cadences, and device health policies.
- Deliver the device compliance signals our Conditional Access policies rely on, working with our IAM Engineer to keep policy and posture in sync.
- Monitor and respond to endpoint telemetry and security alerts, driving remediation with the relevant owners.
- Translate compliance framework requirements (NIST or equivalent) into concrete endpoint controls and documentation.

##### **Escalation and Mentorship**

- Serve as the primary escalation point for our IT Support Specialists on complex hardware, OS, and device issues.
- Mentor the support team and transfer knowledge deliberately so fixes land at tier 1 the next time.
- Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base content in Confluence.

#### **Required Qualifications**

- Experience administering endpoint management including MDM, device compliance, and application deployment.
- Experience building or running zero touch deployment at scale (Autopilot, Apple Business Manager / ADE, or equivalent).
- Ability to write clear documentation and turn written policy into enforceable technical controls.
- Comfort working across abstraction layers, designing systems one day and swapping hardware the next.

#### **Desired Qualifications**

- Experience administering a modern MDM solution such as Intune, Jamf, JumpCloud, or Kandji.
- Comfort with scripting for endpoint automation (PowerShell, bash, Python).
- Familiarity with zero trust concepts and how device posture feeds access decisions.
- Experience supporting or implementing a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent).
- Experience with endpoint telemetry and security alert response, including triage, remediation, and root cause.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

#### **Additional Requirements**

- Available for occasional evening and weekend work to support deployments, maintenance windows, and office moves.
- Travel to vendor sites and other company locations as needed.
- Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours.

#### **Compensation and Benefits**

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

- Cash compensation of $120,000 - $180,000.
- Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.
- A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including:
  - Flexible paid time off
  - Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled)
  - Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA
- Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

#### **Location**

This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located inPortland, Oregon.
