jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Ecosystem Integration team that drives core product integration with Nutanix Partners. You will be closely working with Partners, product management team and solution architect. The role requires deep technical acumen plus an ability to collaborate with various groups inside and outside of the company. The team fosters collaboration, innovation, and excellence, where every team member's contribution is valued and acknowledged. Working within this dynamic team, you will have the chance to learn from some of the best minds in the industry and work on cutting-edge projects that push the boundaries of technology.

About the Team

You will report to the Sr Director, Engineering and work in an onsite setup, where you will be required to be present in the office at least three days a week. This arrangement fosters a sense of camaraderie and allows for more seamless collaboration among team members, leading to increased productivity and creativity. Additionally, being in the office most of the week offers the chance to engage face-to-face with colleagues, enabling better communication and relationship building within the team

**Your Role**

- Contribute to the overall architecture, design and implementation of various integration.

- Ability to coordinate and influence internal and external groups (Solution, External partners, Cross functional engineering, product management) spread across geography.

- Develop a deep understanding of complex distributed systems, and design innovative solutions for customer requirements.

- Work closely with development, test, documentation and product management teams to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.

- Engage with customers and partners when needed to solve production issues.

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 5-8 years of industry experience

- Experience with Virtual Desktop Infrastructure and large-scale distributed systems preferred.

- Love of programming and rock-solid in one or more languages: C#, Python, Golang. Ideally for enterprise-quality software.

- Deep understanding of APIs and extensive experience of APIs development.

- Familiarity with MS technology and its stack including Azure Cloud

- Knowledge of AI tools and its usage in SDLC process.

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 147,000 and USD $ 294,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

--

Requisitos Mínimos:

Experiencia sólida en Windows Server y Active Directory .

Conocimientos de Microsoft Entra ID y entornos híbridos.

Experiencia con SCCM/MECM y conocimientos de Intune.

-
Conocimientos de Microsoft 365 .

-
Experiencia en parcheado, hardening y gestión de vulnerabilidades.

-
Buen nivel de PowerShell y experiencia con PowerCLI .

-
Conocimientos de Terraform .

-
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en entornos productivos críticos.

-
Inglés técnico para documentación y reuniones.

Valorable:

-
Experiencia con Azure Virtual Desktop y FSLogix .

-
Hyper-V y migraciones entre plataformas de virtualización.

-
Exchange Server On-Premises y entornos híbridos.

-
IIS y SQL Server.

-
Certificaciones como VCP-DCV, VCAP, AZ-104, MS-102, SC-300, MD-102 o AZ-140 .

-
Experiencia en automatización y mejora continua de procesos.

 Logicalis Spain somos un grupo internacional con más de 20 años de experiencia en el sector IT, vinculados a proyectos y servicios de gran envergadura en Data Centers, Ciberseguridad y Analytics.

- Formación y certificaciones adaptadas a tu puesto de trabajo.

jobs.summary: JOB DETAILS: The Endpoint Deployment & Manual Remediation Analyst is responsible for executing large-scale endpoint remediation activities, deploying security updates, and performing manual vulnerability remediation where automated solutions are not...
jobs.description:
JOB DETAILS:

The Endpoint Deployment & Manual Remediation Analyst is responsible for executing large-scale endpoint remediation activities, deploying security updates, and performing manual vulnerability remediation where automated solutions are not feasible. The role focuses on reducing security risk, maintaining compliance with remediation SLAs, and resolving deployment issues impacting enterprise endpoints.

Key Responsibilities

 Execute enterprise-wide security patch deployments.
 Perform manual remediation of high-risk vulnerabilities.
 Troubleshoot patch failures and update deployment issues.
 Analyze endpoint compliance and remediation status.
 Coordinate with technology teams to resolve remediation blockers.
 Support vulnerability management reporting and audits.
 Ensure remediation activity compliance with established SLAs.
 Assist in reducing enterprise vulnerability backlog.

Job Summary The EndPoint Administrator supports, maintains, and administers enterprise systems, infrastructure, and application environments. The EndPoint Administrator ensures that systems are functioning efficiently and securely while collaborating with cross-functional teams to support technology operations across the organization.

Essential Functions
Supports and maintains enterprise systems, servers, applications, and related infrastructure.

Responds to hardware, software, and network incidents and service requests, ensuring timely resolution.

Performs system monitoring, maintenance, and patching to ensure optimal performance and compliance.

Maintains accurate documentation of system configurations, procedures, and incident resolutions.

Participates in the on-call rotation to provide after-hours technical support as needed.

Promotes system security, user access controls, and compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.

Collaborates with IT teams and business stakeholders to evaluate and implement technical solutions.

Assists in the deployment and configuration of new systems and upgrades to existing infrastructure.

Follows change management protocols and participates in testing and validation processes.

Complies with all policies and standards.

Package, test, and deploy enterprise applications, third-party software, and patches using MECM, Intune, and WSUS with phased ring deployments.

Build, test, and deploy Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and Intune configuration profiles/security baselines.

Partner with Cybersecurity teams to remediate endpoint vulnerabilities and enforce PCI, CIS, and regulatory compliance standards.

Monitor client agent health, deployment metrics, and assist in maintaining MECM distribution points, management points, and site infrastructure.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred

2-4 years of experience in systems administration required

Experience supporting a mid to large-size enterprise environment preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Experience administering Microsoft SCCM/MECM/InTune and in an enterprise environment.

Strong experience with
o Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), preferred o Microsoft InTune, preferred o Windows Server, preferred o Windows 10/11 administration, preferred o Active Directory, preferred o Group Policy, preferred o PowerShell scripting, preferred o SQL Server reporting, preferred o Windows deployment services, preferred o Endpoint security technologies, preferred

Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration.

Strong understanding of system security, backup, and recovery procedures.

Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

Familiarity with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking concepts.

Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.

Strong communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Licenses and Certifications
Relevant certification in systems administration, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA Server+, or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) preferred

Security or access management certifications, such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security certification preferred

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

 - Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

jobs.description:
What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose
The senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America's modern workplace endpoint platforms. Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The role also encompasses Microsoft Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join strategies for identity-based endpoint access.The senior Client Engineer serves as the North America subject matter expert (SME) and Level 4 escalation authority for client endpoint technologies, defining technical standards, multi-year roadmaps, and architecture that position NA as the global model for modern endpoint engineering. This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.Key Accountabilities
• Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration.
• Define endpoint architecture, standards, and multi-year technology roadmaps for Intune, Microsoft Entra ID Join, Hybrid Entra ID Join, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and mobile device management solutions.
• Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues, leading root cause analysis, problem management, and long-term remediation while providing technical guidance to support teams.
• Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, deployment strategy, and adoption of zero-touch provisioning technologies.
• Partner with Microsoft, Apple, and other technology providers to evaluate emerging solutions, conduct proof-of-concept initiatives, influence product direction, and recommend technology investments.
• Collaborate with security, identity, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure endpoint services align with compliance, governance, security, and digital workplace objectives.
• Develop and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills
Minimum education:

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology (IT) / Networking / Electronics or a related STEM field of study, or equivalent relevant professional experience in the industry along with industry standard certifications.Required Qualifications:
• At least 8 or more years of enterprise endpoint engineering, modern desktop administration, or endpoint management experience.
• 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration and engineering experience supporting Windows and mobile platforms.
• 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join implementations.
• 2+ years of enterprise iOS/iPadOS device management experience using Intune and Apple Business Manager.

Other required technical skills:
• Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management.
• Experience migrating SCCM and Group Policy-managed environments to cloud-native Intune management.
• Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and enterprise iOS deployment practices.
• Experience with Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, endpoint security baselines, compliance reporting, and governance requirements.
• Proficiency in PowerShell automation, Microsoft Graph, reporting, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
• Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, technical documentation, vendor engagement, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communication.

Highly desirables:
• Experience with Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Power BI, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft endpoint management certifications.

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Desktop Engineer to support enterprise laptop refresh and end-user computing initiatives. This role is responsible for imaging and configuring new touchscreen laptops, coordinating shipment and return logistics, maintaining asset inventory records, and providing remote user support to ensure successful device deployment.

The ideal candidate combines technical desktop support skills with strong customer service and project coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Laptop Deployment & Refresh

Configure, image, and deploy Windows-based touchscreen laptops and mobile devices.
Install and validate standard enterprise software, security tools, and configurations.
Perform device setup, testing, and quality assurance prior to shipment.
Execute laptop refresh and replacement programs for remote and onsite users.
Migrate user profiles, files, settings, and applications from existing devices to new hardware.

Asset Management & Inventory

Track and maintain inventory of laptops, peripherals, docking stations, monitors, and accessories.
Manage asset lifecycle from procurement through deployment, recovery, and disposal.
Update asset repositories and CMDB records with accurate device information.
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate hardware ordering as needed.

Shipping & Logistics Coordination

Coordinate shipment of new devices directly to remote users and client locations.
Create shipping labels and track delivery status.
Manage return logistics for old equipment.
Ensure returned devices are received, documented, wiped, and processed according to security policies.
Work with vendors, shipping providers, and internal teams to resolve delivery issues.

Remote User Support

Provide phone, Teams, and remote support to end users during device setup and activation.
Assist users with VPN, Microsoft 365, email, MFA, printers, and network connectivity issues.
Guide employees through laptop migration and onboarding processes.
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues remotely and escalate when appropriate.
Deliver a positive user experience throughout deployment activities.

Technical Support

Support Windows 10/11 operating systems and enterprise desktop environments.
Troubleshoot device performance, security, connectivity, and application issues.
Support Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Intune, SCCM/MECM, VPN, and endpoint security solutions.
Create and maintain deployment, support, and troubleshooting documentation.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of Desktop Support, EUC, or Desktop Engineering experience.
Experience imaging and deploying Windows laptops at scale.
Knowledge of Microsoft Windows 10/11 administration.
Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, or similar endpoint management tools.
Familiarity with Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), and Microsoft 365.
Experience supporting remote users via phone and remote-control tools.
Strong organizational and inventory management skills.
Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting large-scale laptop refresh programs (500+ users).
Knowledge of asset management platforms and CMDB tools.
Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM tools.
A+, Microsoft, or ITIL certification.
Experience supporting touchscreen and mobile device deployments.

Key Skills

Laptop Imaging & Deployment
Windows 10/11 Administration
Microsoft Intune / Autopilot
SCCM / MECM
Microsoft 365 Support
Active Directory / Entra ID
Asset & Inventory Management
Shipping & Logistics Coordination
Remote End User Support
Hardware Refresh Programs
ServiceNow
Customer Service & Communication

Success Metrics

Successful deployment of new laptops with minimal user disruption.
Accurate inventory and asset tracking.
Timely shipment and recovery of devices.
High end-user satisfaction scores.
Reduced deployment and setup issues through proactive support.
Compliance with device security and lifecycle management standards.

jobs.summary: Assume a vital position as a key member of a high-performing team that delivers infrastructure and performance excellence. Your role will be instrumental in shaping the future at one of the world's largest and most influential companies. As a Lead...
jobs.description:
Assume a vital position as a key member of a high-performing team that delivers infrastructure and performance excellence. Your role will be instrumental in shaping the future at one of the world's largest and most influential companies.

 As a Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorganChase within Employee Platforms, you own the packaging, validation, and release execution for Office client software across a global virtual and physical desktop estate.

 In the Microsoft 365 Office Client Engineering space, you own the packaging, validation, and release execution for Office client software across a global virtual and physical desktop estate. You are accountable for getting validated updates and new capabilities onto the desktop safely, at scale, and on a predictable schedule. This is a hands-on engineering role with release accountability. You will build the test and deployment pipeline that turns a multi-week manual cycle into a repeatable run, define the ring strategy and go/no-go criteria that protect line-of-business add-ins and macros, and act as the technical escalation point with Microsoft. The environment is heavily customized and tightly controlled, so speed has to be earned through automation, evidence, and a rollback path that works.

 Job Responsibilities Own engineering, deployment, patching, validation, and support of Office 365 Apps across enterprise desktop environments. Lead release planning and execution using pilot groups, deployment rings, quality gates, and rollback procedures. Automate deployment, testing, monitoring, and operational processes using scripting and infrastructure tools. Troubleshoot complex application and endpoint issues using logs, telemetry, and root-cause analysis. Serve as the technical escalation point for software releases, infrastructure incidents, and vendor support engagements. Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate infrastructure analysis and design documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. Partner with application, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compatibility, compliance, and operational readiness. Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within delivery and automation routines to identify recurring issues and validate remediation options, ensuring changes are traceable/auditable and aligned to resiliency and security expectations. Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 5+ years of applied experience. Deep experience with Microsoft Office 365 deployment, servicing, configuration, and support. Strong expertise with Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Intune, and endpoint management technologies. Experience managing enterprise software releases, deployment governance, validation, and rollback planning. Proven troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across endpoint and infrastructure platforms. Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity. Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations. Deep knowledge of one specific infrastructure technology and scripting languages. Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI-enabled workplace technologies. Experience supporting Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, or similar virtual desktop environments. Experience with application compatibility testing, add-ins, and enterprise software packaging. Experience using telemetry, monitoring, and analytics tools to drive release and operational decisions. Experience implementing automation that improves operational efficiency and reduces manual effort.

jobs.description:
Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced Device Management Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager) and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Device Management Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager) and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The candidate will be responsible for designing, deploying, and managing modern workplace solutions, including device lifecycle management, application deployment, security compliance, and virtual desktop infrastructure on Azure.

 Key Responsibilities

Device Management (Microsoft Intune / MEM)

- Manage end-to-end device lifecycle (enrollment, configuration, compliance, retirement) for Windows, iOS, Android, and macOS devices using Microsoft Intune.

- Design and deploy configuration profiles, compliance policies, and conditional access policies in collaboration with the security team.

- Implement and manage Windows Autopilot for zero-touch device provisioning.

- Package, deploy, and update applications (Win32, MSI, LOB, Microsoft Store apps) via Intune.

- Manage Windows Update for Business rings, feature/quality update deployments, and patch compliance reporting.

- Implement endpoint security policies including BitLocker, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration, ASR rules, and device encryption.

- Handle mobile device management (MDM) and mobile application management (MAM/APP) policies for BYOD and corporate devices.

- Migrate devices from legacy management (SCCM/ConfigMgr, GPO) to modern cloud management, including co-management setups.

Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

- Design, deploy, and manage AVD host pools, application groups, and workspaces.

- Create and maintain golden images using Azure Image Builder / custom images; manage image versioning via Azure Compute Gallery.

- Configure and manage FSLogix profile containers, including storage (Azure Files / Azure NetApp Files) and permissions.

- Implement autoscaling plans to optimize session host capacity and Azure consumption costs.

- Publish RemoteApps and full desktop sessions based on business requirements.

- Monitor AVD environment health, session performance, and user experience using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and AVD Insights.

- Troubleshoot session connectivity, profile load issues, latency, and host performance problems.

General / Cross-Functional

- Administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) — device registration, hybrid join, group management, and conditional access.

- Automate routine tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.

- Maintain documentation — SOPs, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.

- Provide L2/L3 support for escalated endpoint and AVD incidents; work within ITIL-based incident/change management processes.

- Collaborate with security, network, and infrastructure teams on compliance audits and hardening initiatives.

- Stay current with Microsoft roadmap changes and recommend improvements to the modern workplace environment.

 Required Skills & Qualifications

- 4–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure/endpoint management, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune and Azure Virtual Desktop.

- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), conditional access, and identity-driven security.

- Proven experience with Windows Autopilot, application packaging, and compliance/configuration policy design.

- Hands-on experience with FSLogix, host pool management, image management, and AVD scaling.

- Solid PowerShell scripting skills; exposure to Microsoft Graph API is a plus.

- Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, proxy) as they relate to endpoint and AVD connectivity.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security baselines.

- Experience with SCCM/ConfigMgr and co-management scenarios preferred.

- Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

 Preferred Certifications

- MD-102: Microsoft 365 Certified – Endpoint Administrator Associate

- AZ-140: Configuring and Operating Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop

- AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator (nice to have)

- SC-300 or MS-102 (added advantage)

Automation & Self-Healing WorkflowsBuild scalable automation for operational tasks, endpoint health checks, and self-healing remediations using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Ansible.Implement orchestration for automated software deployment, browser extension management, and configuration audits integrated with ServiceNow or enterprise RPA tools. jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.

At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #One Jamf .

What you'll do at Jamf :

In this role the Systems Development Engineer I at Jamf is responsible for automation and development of our backend infrastructure that powers the Jamf Cloud that our customers rely on to manage Apple devices in their organizations. This includes providing the internal infrastructure that our Software Development Engineers use to build and deploy Jamf products in the Cloud.

 You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter.

  What you can expect to do in this role :

- Develop, deploy, and maintain production environments by identifying and applying automation, tools, and techniques such as Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Serverless, and Containerization.

- Ensure security best practices are identified and integrated into system designs and configuration.

- Assist in evaluating, planning, configuration, and implementation of new software services.

- Develop custom tools and automation through programming and scripting.

- Support Software Development by maintaining and scaling our Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery environment as needed.

- Apply Data Lifecycle Management to sensitive data through backups, permissions management, and auditing.

- Participate in an on-call rotation, triaging and escalating alerts, and assisting in disaster recovery as necessary for services the team is responsible for.

- Member of an Agile Team providing code reviews, velocity estimation, planning input, and participating in other Agile Methodology workflows.

- Work and communicate effectively with Product Owners, Development teams, and Cloud and Delivery teams.

- Create and maintain technical documentation.

- Performs other duties as required and completes all job functions as per departmental policies and procedures.

- #LIRemote

What we are looking for:

- Minimum of 1 year experience in one or more of (Required):

  - Continuous Integration Tools and Techniques (e.g. Jenkins, Bamboo, Github Actions)

  - Configuration management and deployment tools (e.g. Ansible, Chef, Puppet).

  - Systems Administration or similar role focused on performance analysis, capacity planning, and forecasting.

- Minimum of 1 year experience as a power user of various operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows, Mac) (Required).

- Minimum of 1 year experience in a current programming language (e.g. Python, Golang) (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience using Source Control Management tools (e.g. Git, Subversion) (Preferred).

- Minimum of 1 year experience using issue tracking software (e.g. JIRA) (Preferred).

- Minimum of 1 year experience developing enterprise grade software with understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (Preferred).

- Minimum of 1 year experience building and maintaining cloud native services with Amazon Web Services (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience working with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. LogicMonitor, Sumologic, ELK) (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience with containerization concepts and Kubernetes (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience working with structured databases (e.g. MySQL, DynamoDB) (Preferred)

- Hands-on experience with AI-driven coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, others to enhance development productivity.

- 4 year / Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

- A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered.

- Certificates commonly held by those in the role include one or more of: LPIC-1, LPIC-2, LPIC-3, RHCE (RedHat Certified Engineer), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified Developer Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Associate. (Preferred)

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- This position will perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen located physically in the U.S., and therefore any employment offer will be contingent upon verification of both of these requirements. Applicants who are not U.S. citizens or who are located outside of the U.S. are strongly encouraged to apply for other positions at Jamf , which is an equal-opportunity employer.

How we help you reach your best potential:

- Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News

- Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024

- Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Our developers work in agile delivery teams to produce new features, improve software components, and are the subject matter experts for our Jamf product offerings.

- You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

- We constantly push the boundaries of technology, our developers support new innovations and OS releases the moment they are made available by Apple.

- Several Jamf engineers are named in patents and with team names like CatDog, ThunderSnow and Dalek you can expect to have some fun while building cutting-edge software.

- You will have the opportunity to work with a small and empowered team where the culture is based on trust, ownership, and respect.

- We offer a clear career path that enables you to grow under supportive leadership and management

- Visit our Jamf Engineering blog to learn more about the innovative projects our team is working on and what we learn from each challenge we solve. A blog written by engineers, for engineers at medium.com/jamf-engineering

- 22 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

- Over 100,000 Jamf Nation users, the largest online IT community in the world.

 Pay Transparency
At Jamf , base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

 The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

 National Pay Transparency Range

 $77,400—$140,340 USD

  What it means to be a Jamf ?We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

  Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

  Above it all, waves our banner of #One Jamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

   What does Jamf do? Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf , customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

  Get social with us and follow the conversation at #One Jamf

 Job Summary

The EndPoint Administrator supports, maintains, and administers enterprise systems, infrastructure, and application environments. This role is responsible for responding to system-related incidents, troubleshooting technical issues, and implementing effective solutions. The EndPoint Administrator ensures that systems are functioning efficiently and securely while collaborating with cross-functional teams to support technology operations across the organization.

 Essential Functions

- Supports and maintains enterprise systems, servers, applications, and related infrastructure.

- Responds to hardware, software, and network incidents and service requests, ensuring timely resolution.

- Performs system monitoring, maintenance, and patching to ensure optimal performance and compliance.

- Maintains accurate documentation of system configurations, procedures, and incident resolutions.

- Participates in the on-call rotation to provide after-hours technical support as needed.

- Promotes system security, user access controls, and compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.

- Collaborates with IT teams and business stakeholders to evaluate and implement technical solutions.

- Assists in the deployment and configuration of new systems and upgrades to existing infrastructure.

- Follows change management protocols and participates in testing and validation processes.

- Identifies and shares best practices with peers and supports continuous improvement initiatives.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

- Maintains regular and reliable attendance.

- Complies with all policies and standards.

Position-Specific Responsibilities

- Package, test, and deploy enterprise applications, third-party software, and patches using MECM, Intune, and WSUS with phased ring deployments.

- Build, test, and deploy Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and Intune configuration profiles/security baselines.

- Partner with Cybersecurity teams to remediate endpoint vulnerabilities and enforce PCI, CIS, and regulatory compliance standards.

- Monitor client agent health, deployment metrics, and assist in maintaining MECM distribution points, management points, and site infrastructure.

Qualifications

- H.S. Diploma or GED required

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred

- 2-4 years of experience in systems administration required

- Experience supporting a mid to large-size enterprise environment preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

- Experience administering Microsoft SCCM/MECM/InTune and in an enterprise environment.

- Strong experience with:
o Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), preferred

o Microsoft InTune, preferred

o Windows Server, preferred

o Windows 10/11 administration, preferred
o Active Directory, preferred
o Group Policy, preferred
o PowerShell scripting, preferred
o SQL Server reporting, preferred
o Windows deployment services, preferred
o Endpoint security technologies, preferred

- Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration.

- Strong understanding of system security, backup, and recovery procedures.

- Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

- Familiarity with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking concepts.

- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.

- Strong communication and customer service skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Licenses and Certifications

- Relevant certification in systems administration, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA Server+, or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) preferred

- Security or access management certifications, such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security certification preferred

With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details

Under the direction of the Director of IT Infrastructure, the Systems Administrator will provide technical assistance and guidance to build and monitor information technology assets on premise and cloud based. This role will provide administration to maintain and resolve problems associated to servers and systems for the organization. The ideal candidate for this role will be a subject matter expert in server, storage and cloud infrastructure. You will be able to efficiently build, maintain and monitor said infrastructures to allow ExactCare to meet organizational objectives. ExactCare fosters a high-performing environment driven by our Core Values and commitment to our Patient Promise.

Responsibilities

- Install new / rebuild existing servers and configure hardware, peripherals, services, settings, directories, storage, etc. in accordance with standards and project/operational requirements

- Install and perform repairs to servers, software, end user devices or peripheral equipment, following design or installation specifications

- Assist in maintaining the daily performance of server environment

- Maintain, monitor and troubleshoot physical and virtual server infrastructure

- Monitor the system daily and respond immediately to security or usability concerns

- Upgrade systems and processes as required for enhanced functionality and security issue resolution

- Assist with implementing cloud-based assets and solutions

- Maintain, monitor and troubleshoot Windows server environment and related systems

- Maintain, monitor and troubleshoot network based services: File and Print services, Exchange 2013, O365/Exchange Online, Active Directory, DHCP/DNS.

- Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot windows server software deployments

- Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux server software deployments

- Provide Tier 3 support for customers and technical staff as needed

- Assist in the testing of backup and disaster recovery processes and procedures

- Prepare and maintain written documentation of server, cloud and application environments

- Maintain the highest level of security practices in accordance with the current industry and corporate standards

- Other duties as assigned

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. We are looking for an intermediate level profile for daily operational support and administration for Microsoft cloud services such as SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Defender,

The roles involve handling incoming tickets, creating documentation on the existing infrastructure, and supporting the Platform Manager creating governance policies, monitor and change management of new features released by Microsoft. The contractors will also collaborate with administrators of other Microsoft 365 services to ensure smooth platform operations

 Daily Operations and Ticket Management for SharePoint, Intune, Defender, Purview, OneDrive, Copilot

- Efficiently manage and resolve daily support tickets related to the Microsoft services, ensuring timely and effective issue resolution.

- Monitor platform performance and escalate issues when necessary, with Microsoft.

- Workload report and ongoing tasks within the team meetings (weekly)

- Use of PowerShell to update system configurations when applicable.

Documentation

- Create and maintain documentation of the current infrastructure.

- Ensure documentation is up-to-date and accessible to relevant stakeholders.

- Update documentation based on the new features released by Microsoft, including material for change management.

3. Platform Support

- Provide ongoing technical and operational support to the Platform Managers.

- Assist in platform migrations and configuration changes.

Administration of Microsoft 365 platforms

- Administer SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Defender, Purview and Copilot (more detailed in section 2).

- Coordinate with administrators of other Microsoft 365 services (e.g., Teams, OneDrive, Exchange) to ensure integrated platform support.

- Participate in cross-functional meetings and contribute to platform-wide initiatives.

- Handle tickets of other Microsoft services that are introduced under the responsibility of Digital Workplace service (e.g. Microsoft Bookings, Viva Insight, Purview or other Microsoft 365 applications)

Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities for automation and process optimisation.

- Propose improvements to enhance user experience and platform efficiency.

Microsoft 365 administration activities

SPECIFIC EXPERTISE:

Endpoint Management – Microsoft Intune

Ability to design, deploy and troubleshoot modern endpoint management such as:

o Design and implement device enrollment strategies (Autopilot, BYOD, corporateowned)

o Create and maintain compliance policies (e.g., encryption, OS version, secure boot) o Configure and deploy configuration profiles (Wi-Fi, VPN, certificates, security baselines)

o Package and deploy applications (Win32, Microsoft Store, LOB apps) o Implement and manage Windows Update rings and feature update policies o Troubleshoot device compliance, enrollment failures, and policy conflicts o Implement Conditional Access integration with Intune compliance

o Support mobile device management (iOS/Android) including app protection policies

Security Operations – Microsoft Defender Suite

Hands-on experience with endpoint security, threat detection, and response.

o Configure and manage Microsoft Defender for Endpoint policies o Investigate and respond to security incidents and alerts o Perform threat hunting using advanced hunting queries (KQL) o Tune detection rules to reduce false positives

o Implement and manage attack surface reduction (ASR) rules o Configure device control policies (USB, removable media) o Integrate Defender with Intune and Conditional Access o Produce security reports and recommend improvements o Support vulnerability management and remediation tracking

Virtual Desktop – Azure VDI

Ability to deploy and operate scalable virtual desktop environments. o Design and deploy Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments o Configure host pools, application groups, and workspaces o Optimize session host performance (FSLogix profiles, scaling) o Implement image management strategy (golden image, updates)

o Configure identity integration with Azure AD / Entra ID o Monitor and troubleshoot user sessions and performance issues o Implement cost optimization strategies (auto-scaling, VM sizing) o Secure AVD environment using Defender and Conditional Access o Support end-user connectivity issues and access troubleshooting

 Identity & Access (Supporting Scope)

Strong understanding of identity as the control plane. o Configure and manage Conditional Access policies o Implement MFA and passwordless authentication o Manage role-based access control (RBAC) o Support B2B / guest access scenarios o Integrate applications with Azure AD / Entra ID SSO o Monitor and respond to risky sign-ins and identity alerts

 Cross-Platform & Operational Tasks o Document solutions and maintain operational runbooks o Automate tasks using PowerShell / Graph API

o Participate in service acceptance and transition to operations

o Work with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions o Ensure compliance with security and governance standards o Provide knowledge transfer to internal teams

BEST PRACTICES

- Adhere to IT Service Management (ITSM) best practices, ensuring consistent, efficient, and customer-focused service delivery.

- Comply with the organisation’s security policies and data protection regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

- Safeguard sensitive information through appropriate handling and confidentiality measures.

- Apply appropriate access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can access relevant systems and data.

- Maintain audit trails for all administrative actions to support accountability and traceability.

Only EU Citizens

jobs.description:
About the RoleWe are seeking an experienced Level 3 Engineer and Microsoft 365 Specialist to design, build, and strengthen internal technology platforms while delivering high-quality technical support across a diverse small-business client environment.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Level 3 Engineer and Microsoft 365 Specialist to design, build, and strengthen internal technology platforms while delivering high-quality technical support across a diverse small-business client environment.

This is a hands-on position suited to an experienced MSP professional who combines strong technical capability with a practical builder mindset. The initial focus will be on enhancing internal systems, configuring and improving RMM and PSA platforms, strengthening documentation and service-management standards, and uplifting Microsoft 365 security and endpoint-management environments.

You will also provide Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 incident triage, incident management, and technical support while proactively identifying opportunities to improve security, scalability, automation, and service delivery.

About the Client

You will be working with a South Australian managed services provider supporting a carefully selected portfolio of small-business clients. The organisation combines enterprise-level technology expertise with a personalised, trusted-partner approach and is entering an exciting stage of growth.

As part of this growth, the business is strengthening its internal systems, tools, security controls, and service-management capabilities to deliver increasingly secure, structured, and scalable technology services.

Ideal Profile

Experience & Role Requirements

- Minimum five years of relevant experience across IT engineering, systems administration, or technical support.

- Demonstrated Level 3 capability within Microsoft 365 environments, including strong hands-on experience with Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and Microsoft Purview.

- Previous experience working within a managed services provider environment.

- Proven ability to design, implement, and support production systems rather than solely administer established environments.

- Strong incident triage and incident-management experience across Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 issues.

- Experience configuring or improving RMM and PSA platforms and associated workflows.

- Working knowledge across networking, endpoint management, identity, security, backup, and SaaS administration.

- Ability to audit technology environments, identify control or configuration gaps, and deliver structured remediation.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills with excellent technical documentation discipline.

Technical Skills

- Strong Microsoft 365 administration and security expertise.

- Hands-on capability with Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and mobile device management.

- Experience with Microsoft Purview, data loss prevention, and information/document classification.

- Knowledge of RMM and remote-support platforms; NinjaOne experience is highly regarded, while TeamViewer familiarity is beneficial.

- Experience configuring PSA platforms and service-management workflows.

- Microsoft Azure capability, particularly virtual machine and terminal-server provisioning, is highly regarded.

- Experience with Microsoft 365 and SaaS backup solutions, including NinjaOne SaaS Backup, is advantageous.

- Familiarity with multi-tenant management solutions such as CIPP or Microsoft Lighthouse is advantageous.

- Experience supporting Ubiquiti UniFi networking and Lenovo and HP desktop environments.

- Sound understanding of SaaS concepts, cybersecurity controls, and secure administration practices.

Qualifications & Certifications

- Relevant Microsoft certifications covering Microsoft 365, endpoint management, security, or Azure, or equivalent demonstrable technical capability.

- ITIL certification is highly regarded, supported by practical knowledge of IT service management and change management.

- A tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline is desirable.

Professional Attributes

- Methodical, structured, and highly attentive to detail.

- Proactive and self-directed, with the confidence to identify priorities and recommend improvements.

- Strong commitment to clear, accurate, and maintainable technical documentation.

- Practical builder mindset with ownership of solution quality, usability, and maintainability.

- Comfortable balancing platform-development initiatives with client support requirements in a growing MSP environment.

- Curious about AI, automation, and emerging technologies, with an ability to explore them responsibly.

- Reliable and trustworthy when managing privileged access to client environments.

Responsibilities

- Design, configure, and continuously improve internal IT systems, tools, and service-delivery capabilities.

- Build and administer remote monitoring and management environments, including supporting the transition toward NinjaOne and existing TeamViewer capabilities.

- Configure and enhance PSA platforms and associated operational workflows.

- Deliver Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 technical support, including incident triage and incident management.

- Implement and administer Microsoft Intune, Conditional Access, Windows Autopilot, and mobile device management environments.

- Configure Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data loss prevention and information/document classification.

- Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 and SaaS backup solutions.

- Support secure administration across multiple Microsoft 365 tenants using appropriate tenant-management platforms.

- Assess and audit internal and client environments, identifying security, configuration, and control gaps and implementing structured improvements.

- Support Microsoft Azure and broader systems-engineering activities, including virtual machine and terminal-server provisioning.

- Configure and support Ubiquiti UniFi networking environments and Lenovo and HP desktop devices.

- Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, implementation records, standards, procedures, and change records.

- Apply structured IT service-management and change-management practices across technical work.

- Help strengthen client environments against relevant cybersecurity standards and controls, including SMB1001 Gold where applicable.

- Explore practical applications of AI and automation to improve internal processes, service delivery, and client outcomes.

- Proactively identify priorities, ask informed questions, and recommend improvements with limited day-to-day direction.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace

🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities
🧠 Diji Assist – Mental health & counseling support when you need it
📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones

Posted Job Title

Senior IT Endpoint Support Specialist

Job Profile Title

Information Technology Support Specialist Senior

Job Description Summary

ISC's HireIT Services team provides best-in-class IT service delivery in a matrix environment to clients across a diverse collection of campus organizations.

As a senior member of the Endpoint Services team, the Senior IT Support Specialist provides advanced endpoint administration, technical consulting, and end-user support for both macOS and Windows computing environments, with primary responsibility for the management and advancement of HireIT's Apple ecosystem. This position is responsible for the design, implementation, and ongoing management of endpoint services, including software deployment, operating system management, patching, security remediation, and device lifecycle management. While supporting a mixed-platform environment, the position serves as a lead technical resource for macOS management, leveraging Jamf Pro and related technologies to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint services.

The successful candidate will build strong client relationships, mentor junior staff, and help ensure secure, reliable, and well-managed endpoint computing services. Additionally, they should have Jamf 200 certification or equivalent demonstrated experience administering Jamf Pro in an enterprise environment. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required.

Job Description

Administer and support endpoint management services for Windows and macOS devices, including operating system upgrades, software deployment, patch management, security remediation, and compliance monitoring.Provide advanced technical support and consulting for clients with varying levels of technical expertise.Serve as an escalation point for complex endpoint, application, and device management issues while maintaining strong client relationships and delivering exemplary customer service.Design, implement, and continuously improve endpoint management processes, standards, workflows, and automation.Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that enhance endpoint security, manageability, and user experience.Participate in initiatives, testing and projects undertaken by the Endpoint Team.Manage endpoint lifecycle activities including imaging, provisioning, deployment, asset management, refresh programs, inventory reconciliation, and hardware replacement initiatives.Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, procedures, and client communications related to endpoint services. Occasional coverage for evenings, weekends, and recognized University holidays may be required.Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Jamf 200 certification or equivalent demonstrated experience administering and scripting Jamf Pro in an enterprise environment.Ability to thrive in a client-centric, technically-focused environment. Organizational skills: the ability to create and keep deadlines, goal setting, and time management. Ability to work with a wide variety of clients and colleagues, delivering exemplary technical support and mentorship. Ability and commitment to maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive materials. Experience configuring, deploying and supporting client systems in a highly managed environment. jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is scaling its India Global Capability Centre, and we're hiring a Senior Manager to lead IT End User Services, including our Security & Desktop Systems team and our IT Automation Engineering team, supporting a Mac-first environment (roughly 80% macOS, 20% Windows).

You'll lead two complementary teams that keep Smartsheet's global workforce productive and secure.

The first is our Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, a cross-functional team that pairs Service Desk support with first-line security triage and response. Employees get one team that fixes their problems and protects them. The second is our IT Automation Engineers, who build the tooling that makes that work faster and more consistent.

You'll set the operating standards, own performance against SLAs and quality targets, and shape the automation roadmap so repetitive work disappears and service quality rises.

For the right candidate, this role has a clear path to Director as we continue scaling our India GCC, with that step anticipated within 12-18 months.

You'll report to the Sr. Director of End User Systems and partner day to day with our US-based Desktop Support managers, shaping how both regions work together.

#### You Will

**Security & Desktop Systems Team**

- Lead the India-based Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, working daily with US counterparts to align priorities, coverage, and ways of working
- Own team performance against SLAs, quality standards, and service desk metrics, and drive continuous improvement
- Oversee resolution of tickets across hardware, software, network, and user access
- Own desktop administration across a Mac-first fleet (macOS and Windows), including software deployment, system configuration, user provisioning, enrollment, and hardware lifecycle management
- Step in hands-on when volumes spike, critical issues arise, or the team needs support, and coach people through the fix
- Ensure knowledge base articles and process documentation are current, high quality, and consistently maintained

**Security Operations (Tier 1)**

- Oversee the team's first-line SOC responsibilities, including alert triage, escalation, and response
- Ensure the team follows incident response playbooks, and improve them as threats and tooling evolve
- Partner with the wider security organisation so Tier 1 handoffs are fast, accurate, and well documented
- Track SOC quality and response metrics, and build the team's security capability over time
- Balance support and security workload so neither is neglected as volumes change

**IT Automation Engineering**

- Lead the IT Automation Engineers, setting priorities and owning the automation roadmap
- Identify high-volume, repetitive Tier 1 work, prioritise it by impact, and ensure it is automated and measured
- Identify where AI-augmented workflows can meaningfully reduce toil (e.g. intelligent ticket triage, SOC alert summarisation, AI-assisted knowledge base drafting) and direct the team in delivering them
- Set automation standards, review technical designs before deployment, and help debug when automations fail or stall
- Coach engineers on best practices

**People Leadership**

- Set clear direction, track progress, remove blockers, and escalate capacity constraints
- Design and lead onboarding for new team members
- Coach and mentor India-based engineers and specialists, support their career growth, and hire and develop top technical talent

#### You Have

**Experience**

- 8+ years in IT support, Service Desk, or end user services operations, with deep working knowledge of the systems and processes involved
- 4+ years leading technical support teams in matrixed or distributed organisations
- Direct experience overseeing or working in security operations, such as SOC triage, alert response, or incident response
- Experience leading or working closely with engineers who build automation or integrations, with enough technical grounding to review their work and set direction
- A track record of setting direction and delivering cross-functional projects through ambiguity

RANGO SALARIAL: $140,000 USD - $160,000 USD

La compensación específica se basará en la experiencia, habilidades,
calificaciones, consideraciones comerciales y otros factores relacionados con el
puesto permitidos por la ley. En Russell Investments, el salario es solo una parte de
nuestro paquete de compensación. Nuestro enfoque de recompensas totales
incluye un bono anual por desempeño (sujeto a criterios de elegibilidad) además
de la participación en nuestros programas competitivos de beneficios, que
incluyen atención médica, jubilación, vacaciones y programas de bienestar.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL PUESTO:

En Russell Investments, nuestro propósito es mejorar la seguridad financiera de las
personas.

Buscamos un Ingeniero Senior de Ciberseguridad – IAM y Seguridad de Endpoints
para liderar el diseño y la ingeniería de las capacidades de seguridad de
identidad, endpoints y acceso privilegiado en un entorno híbrido global.

Este rol combina experiencia práctica en ingeniería con alineación
arquitectónica, centrándose en soluciones escalables, automatizadas y basadas
en el riesgo, fundamentadas en los principios de Confianza Cero (Zero Trust).

RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE

* Liderar la implementación y optimización de controles de identidad,
  endpoints y acceso privilegiado en entornos híbridos.

* Gestionar el ciclo de vida de la identidad, la seguridad de endpoints y
  la gobernanza de accesos, asegurando configuraciones seguras y la
  aplicación coherente de estándares.

* Impulsar la automatización y la eficiencia operativa en los procesos de
  aprovisionamiento, cumplimiento y gestión de accesos.

* Aplicar los principios de Confianza Cero (Zero Trust) y modelado de
  amenazas para fortalecer el diseño de seguridad de identidad y endpoints.

* Colaborar con Operaciones de Ciberseguridad para mejorar las capacidades
  de detección, respuesta y monitorización de controles.

* Realizar evaluaciones de riesgos y validación de controles, centrándose
  en el compromiso de identidad y las amenazas de endpoints.

* Colaborar con equipos globales y mentorizar a ingenieros para promover
  prácticas de seguridad consistentes y escalables.

CALIFICACIONES Y EXPERIENCIA

* Más de 8 años de experiencia en ingeniería de ciberseguridad.

* Sólida experiencia práctica en IAM, seguridad de endpoints y gestión de
  acceso privilegiado.

* Experiencia en entornos híbridos (on-premises y cloud).

* Capacidad para traducir principios arquitectónicos en soluciones de
  ingeniería prácticas.

* Se requiere título de Grado universitario.

* Certificaciones preferidas: CISSP, CISM o equivalente.

EXPERTISE TÉCNICO

* Gestión de Identidad y Acceso (autenticación, autorización, federación,
  gobernanza)

* Gestión de Acceso Privilegiado y aplicación del principio de mínimo
  privilegio

* Seguridad de endpoints, hardening y detección/respuesta de amenazas

* Gestión de dispositivos y cumplimiento de endpoints

* Arquitectura de Confianza Cero (Zero Trust) y modelos de seguridad
  centrados en la identidad

* Modelado de amenazas y prácticas de seguridad basadas en el riesgo

* Automatización/scripting para operaciones de seguridad

* Familiaridad con los marcos NIST, ISO y CIS

COMPETENCIAS BÁSICAS

* Liderazgo técnico y resolución de problemas práctica

* Toma de decisiones basada en el riesgo

* Colaboración entre equipos globales

* Comunicación clara y efectiva

VALORES Y CULTURA

* Actuar con integridad innegociable y mantener los más altos estándares
  profesionales.

* Demostrar curiosidad intelectual, buscando avanzar continuamente la
  postura de ingeniería de ciberseguridad de la firma.

* Encarnar la colaboración, la transparencia y la responsabilidad en todos
  los compromisos.

* Dedicado a proteger la confianza del cliente a través de la excelencia en
  seguridad y la gestión proactiva de riesgos.

REQUISITOS ESPECIALES

* Soporte ocasional fuera del horario laboral para operaciones globales

Este puesto no es elegible para patrocinio de inmigración basado en
empleo.

Los solicitantes deben estar legalmente autorizados para trabajar en los
Estados Unidos sin patrocinio del empleador, ahora o en el futuro.

IGUALDAD DE OPORTUNIDADES DE EMPLEO

Russell Investments se compromete a proporcionar igualdad de oportunidades de
empleo para todos los asociados y solicitantes de empleo, independientemente de
raza, religión, ascendencia, credo, color, género (incluida la identidad de
género, que se refiere al sexo real o percibido de una persona, e incluye la
autoimagen, apariencia, comportamiento o expresión, ya sea diferente o no de lo
tradicionalmente asociado con el sexo biológico de una persona), edad, origen
nacional, estatus de ciudadanía, discapacidad, condición médica, estatus militar,
estado de veterano, estado civil, orientación sexual, estado de desempleo
pasado o presente, o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.
