jobs.description:
Power the Future of Innovation and Excellence Across Enterprise Applications

Georgia System Operations Corporation (GSOC) is seeking a Senior Digital Workplace Engineer to administer, support, enhance, and continuously improve the organization's Digital Workplace ecosystem across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, enterprise content management, workflow automation, document management, scanning technologies, and application platforms.

This senior technical role supports cloud-based and on-premises technologies while advancing modernization across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, document management, workflow, and enterprise application platforms.

The Senior Digital Workplace Engineer partners with business stakeholders, product owners, and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable, and modern collaboration and content management solutions.

This is an onsite position and it is not eligible for visa sponsorship

What You'll Do

As a Senior Digital Workplace Engineer, you will combine platform administration, application support, automation, content services, and infrastructure expertise to improve how employees collaborate, manage information, and get work done.

You Will

Administer, support, enhance, and continuously improve Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online, and legacy SharePoint environments.Administer enterprise document management, records management, content services, scanning, imaging, OCR, and document capture solutions.Monitor platform performance, storage, security, service health, user provisioning, access controls, and governance standards.Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for Digital Workplace applications and business-critical solutions hosted on Windows Server and IIS.Troubleshoot application, authentication, integration, workflow, and performance issues and coordinate vendor support activities.Support software lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, testing, deployment, backup validation, and disaster recovery activities.Design, configure, and support business solutions using Power Apps and Power Automate.Modernize legacy forms and workflows, including InfoPath and legacy SharePoint solutions.Develop PowerShell automation scripts that improve operational efficiency and platform administration.Support integrations among Microsoft 365, enterprise applications, SQL databases, and third-party platforms.Configure metadata, taxonomy, retention policies, content types, and governance controls.Support document capture, indexing, workflow routing, and content lifecycle processes.Administer Windows Server environments and manage IIS configurations, application deployments, certificates, and web application troubleshooting.Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity, and business teams to ensure secure and compliant operations.Develop and maintain operational documentation, support procedures, and knowledge articles.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education, training, and directly related work experience may be considered.Ideally, 6+ years of experience with SharePoint, including on-premises and online environments, Microsoft 365, and enterprise content management.Strong experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), React, Angular, .NET, C#, and ASP.NET.Experience with InfoPath forms and Nintex workflows, including migration to cloud-based solutions.Hands-on expertise with Power Apps, Power Automate, and advanced PowerShell scripting.Experience managing Microsoft Teams and integrations.Experience administering Windows Server and IIS environments.Deep understanding of SharePoint and Teams architecture, governance, and security.Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical documentation skills.Ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives and work effectively with business stakeholders, product owners, technology teams, and third-party providers.

Preferred Qualifications

Digital Workplace Engineering

Experience engineering and supporting Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and hybrid SharePoint environments.Experience developing SharePoint solutions using SPFx, React, Angular, .NET, C#, or ASP.NET.Experience managing Microsoft Teams integrations and developing Teams apps, bots, or Copilot and agent solutions.

Workflow Automation & Modernization

Experience designing solutions with Power Apps and Power Automate.Experience modernizing InfoPath forms, Nintex workflows, and legacy SharePoint solutions.Advanced PowerShell scripting experience for platform administration and operational automation.

Content Services & Platform Operations

Experience with enterprise document management, records management, metadata, taxonomy, retention, document capture, OCR, and content lifecycle processes.Experience with SharePoint migration tools such as ShareGate or AvePoint.Experience supporting Windows Server, IIS, SQL integrations, certificates, application deployments, patching, backup validation, and disaster recovery.

Advantages of Working at GSOC

Working at GSOC means more than just a job--it's an opportunity to contribute to work that truly matters.

Digital Workplace Leadership

Influence the reliability, usability, governance, and continued evolution of enterprise collaboration, content management, workflow, and application platforms.

Modernization & Automation

Advance Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, workflow automation, and hybrid technology modernization initiatives.

Mission-Driven Impact

Your work helps strengthen the technology platforms and services that support critical operations across the Family of Companies.

Strong Values and Professional Standards

Work in an environment grounded in accountability, collaboration, integrity, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Work Environment & Benefits

GSOC offers a professional, collaborative work environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for continuous professional growth.

Why Join GSOC

At GSOC, you will serve as a senior technical resource for the Digital Workplace ecosystem while helping shape secure, scalable, and modern collaboration, content management, workflow, and enterprise application capabilities.

Apply Today

If you're ready to modernize enterprise collaboration, strengthen Microsoft 365 and SharePoint platforms, and improve how people connect with information and technology, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Overview:

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham's IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you'll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In this role you will:
• Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools-helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions.
• Partner directly with business units to consult on process challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design and build solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph.
• Actively engage with vendors and the broader AI and automation community to stay ahead of emerging tools, techniques, and best practices, bringing new capabilities back to the firm.
• Provide insightful feedback to IT leadership on AI and automation tooling to help shape strategic product and engineering decisions.
• Partner with IT to champion standards, governance, and best practices for citizen development and AI usage across the Power Platform and beyond, including automation of identity and access workflows in Microsoft Entra ID.
• Drive adoption and best practices across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), partnering with the broader Digital Workplace Services team on the firm's core collaboration tools.
• Take ownership of key performance indicators tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and employee engagement with AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools.
• Lead engagements with the business to understand challenges and propose solutions for process improvement and business process automation.

Your impact:
• Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm's broader network of technology champions
• Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity
• Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement
• Be a key contributor to developing IT's vision and roadmap for AI, automation, and modern workplace strategy

Contributors to your success:
• 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption.
• Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions.
• Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team.
• Hands-on experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), PowerShell scripting, and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (identity, access, and app registrations) is a plus.
• Strong emphasis on customer service and the ability to teach people of all technical abilities.
• Practical experience applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Codex, Cursor) to real business problems, with enthusiasm for staying current on the fast-evolving AI landscape.
• Experience with Lean process improvement is a plus

For Denver based candidates, the compensation range for the position is expected to be between $82,000 and $100,000 annually. Total compensation, including base pay, discretionary individual bonus and company bonus, may be higher than range listed, depending on applicant's skills, qualifications, and experience. Benefits include health insurance, life and disability insurance, 401k, EAP, paid holidays and paid time off.

Client Overview

Our client is a well-established national organization seeking an experienced Endpoint / Infrastructure Engineer to join its New York City technology team. This is a hands-on engineering position focused on resolving complex endpoint and infrastructure issues, improving the overall stability of the environment, and identifying root causes rather than providing temporary fixes.

Salary/Hourly Rate

$30/hr - $45/hr

Position Overview

The Endpoint / Infrastructure Engineer will provide advanced technical support and engineering across the organization's endpoint environment. This is not a traditional Service Desk position. The ideal candidate will have the technical depth to troubleshoot issues across the full technology pathway, including the endpoint, operating system, applications, identity, connectivity, device management, and supporting backend infrastructure.

The environment is currently experiencing a high volume of technical issues, so this person will be expected to look beyond individual tickets, recognize patterns, perform root-cause analysis, and implement solutions that prevent recurring problems.

Responsibilities Of The Endpoint / Infrastructure Engineer

Own and troubleshoot complex endpoint and infrastructure issues from initial investigation through resolution.Perform in-depth root-cause analysis rather than relying solely on break/fix solutions.Troubleshoot across the full technical pathway, including endpoints, applications, authentication, networking/connectivity, device management, and backend systems.Support and engineer enterprise Windows and macOS environments.Manage endpoint configuration, enrollment, compliance, patching, provisioning, and application deployments.Administer and troubleshoot endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, or similar technologies.Investigate failed deployments, non-compliant devices, recurring workstation issues, and performance problems.Support Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange/Office 365, and related infrastructure.Develop and improve PowerShell scripts and automation for endpoint administration and remediation.Package, test, deploy, and troubleshoot enterprise applications and configuration changes.Support endpoint security initiatives including patching, encryption, EDR, device compliance, and vulnerability remediation.Identify recurring trends across support issues and develop scalable technical solutions.Partner with Service Desk and other infrastructure/engineering resources on escalated technical issues.Create technical documentation and improve processes for recurring issues.Assist with workstation provisioning, hardware refreshes, and device lifecycle management.Work with third-party vendors on hardware, warranty, and technical issues.

Required Experience/Skills For The Endpoint / Infrastructure Engineer

Strong background in Endpoint Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Desktop Engineering, or advanced L3 technical support.Ability to troubleshoot complex issues end-to-end, including backend components.Advanced experience supporting Windows enterprise environments.Experience supporting macOS in a corporate environment.Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune or comparable endpoint management technology.Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and enterprise identity/authentication.Experience with application deployment, patching, device compliance, and endpoint security.Strong root-cause analysis and advanced troubleshooting skills.Working knowledge of PowerShell and technical automation.Ability to recognize patterns across recurring incidents and implement long-term technical solutions.Strong communication skills and ability to work across Service Desk, Endpoint, Infrastructure, and Security teams.

Preferred Experience/Skills For The Endpoint / Infrastructure Engineer

5-7+ years of experience within a large enterprise/corporate IT environment.Experience with Intune, Jamf, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, or similar platforms.Experience packaging and deploying enterprise applications.PowerShell scripting and endpoint remediation experience.Experience troubleshooting both endpoint and supporting backend infrastructure.Microsoft Graph or API-based administration experience.Experience with ServiceNow, Zendesk, or comparable ITSM platforms.Familiarity with ITIL practices.Relevant Microsoft, Apple, CompTIA, or infrastructure certifications.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent relevant technical experience.

Benefits

Atrium Care Package available, upon eligibility (including healthcare plans, discount programs, and paid time off).

jobs.description:
The Principal Engineer for Digital Workplace Technology is a senior technical leader within NBCUniversal’s Workplace Technology Engineering (WTE) organization, responsible for defining and delivering the next-generation digital workplace platform.

The Principal Engineer for Digital Workplace Technology is a senior technical leader within NBCUniversal ’s Workplace Technology Engineering (WTE) organization, responsible for defining and delivering the next-generation digital workplace platform. This role spans enterprise collaboration, endpoint engineering, and AI platform engineering, including Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, and enterprise AI solutions. This position plays a critical role in transforming NBCU’s digital workplace into an AI-first productivity platform that powers employee communication, engagement, and innovation.

Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Architecture

- Define and lead the technical vision, roadmap, and standards for NBCU’s digital
workplace platforms across collaboration, endpoints, and AI.

- Own the end-to-end architecture for Workplace Technology Engineering, ensuring
alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements.

- Serve as a technical authority for complex system design, scalability, and long-term
 platform evolution.

Digital Workplace Platform Engineering

- Lead design and engineering of enterprise workplace services, including:

- Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online)

- Identity & security (Entra ID, Purview, Defender)

- Endpoint engineering (Intune, JAMF, SCCM)

- Unified communications, telephony, and conferencing solutions

- Ensure platforms deliver high availability, performance, and security, while reducing operational overhead through automation and standardization.

- Drive global consistency across workplace technologies supporting hybrid work environments.

AI & Workplace Intelligence Engineering

- Architect and deliver enterprise AI capabilities, including:

  - Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio

  - Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)

  - Enterprise AI and low-code automation solutions

- Lead the engineering of agentic AI solutions, automation workflows, and knowledge systems that enhance employee productivity and decision-making.

- Establish standards for:

  - AI governance, security, and responsible use

  - Data protection, privacy, and compliance within AI solutions

- Partner with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases across NBCU.

Engineering Excellence & SRE Practices

- Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across workplace platforms:

  - Define and manage SLIs/SLOs

  - Improve observability and monitoring

  - Automate operations to reduce manual toil

- Drive reliability, resilience, and operational excellence across global services supporting collaboration, endpoints, and AI platforms.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

- Act as a senior technical leader and mentor across WTE engineering teams.

- Lead architecture reviews, engineering design boards, and technical decision-making forums.

- Partner closely with:

  - Workplace Operations

  - Cybersecurity & Risk

  - Enterprise Architecture

  - Product & Business stakeholders

- Influence strategic decisions and ensure alignment between technology investments and business outcomes.

Innovation & Transformation

- Drive modernization initiatives across workplace platforms, including cloud migration, endpoint transformation, and AI adoption.

- Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies in:

  - Generative AI and LLM ecosystems

  - Digital employee experience (DEX) platforms

  - Automation and low-code development

Enable continuous improvement of employee experience across NBCU’s global workforce.

- 12+ years of experience in enterprise engineering, platform engineering, or workplace technology

- Deep expertise in:

  - Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, OneDrive)

  - Endpoint engineering and device management platforms (Intune, JAMF, SCCM)

  - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

- Strong experience in AI/ML or enterprise AI engineering, including Copilot or similar platforms

- Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform

- Knowledge of MLOps, DevOps, and platform engineering best practices

- Experience in media, entertainment, or large global enterprise environments

- Familiarity with NBCU-specific platforms (e.g. Intranet, employee portals, custom digital experiences)

- Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise platform transformations

- Strong architectural, analytical, and problem-solving skills

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

- Strong business acuity, including understanding and practical application of relevant market/industry trends

- Ability to thrive in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment and to manage multiple simultaneous projects requiring organization and time management.

Excelente ambiente de trabajo y proyectos de alto impacto tecnológico.

jobs.description:
Overview

Job Description:

We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham’s IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you’ll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In This Role You Will

 Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools—helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions. Partner directly with business units to consult on process challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design and build solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph. Actively engage with vendors and the broader AI and automation community to stay ahead of emerging tools, techniques, and best practices, bringing new capabilities back to the firm. Provide insightful feedback to IT leadership on AI and automation tooling to help shape strategic product and engineering decisions. Partner with IT to champion standards, governance, and best practices for citizen development and AI usage across the Power Platform and beyond, including automation of identity and access workflows in Microsoft Entra ID. Drive adoption and best practices across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), partnering with the broader Digital Workplace Services team on the firm’s core collaboration tools. Take ownership of key performance indicators tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and employee engagement with AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools. Lead engagements with the business to understand challenges and propose solutions for process improvement and business process automation.

Your Impact

 Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm’s broader network of technology champions Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement Be a key contributor to developing IT’s vision and roadmap for AI, automation, and modern workplace strategy

Contributors To Your Success

 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption. Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions. Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team. Hands-on experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), PowerShell scripting, and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (identity, access, and app registrations) is a plus. Strong emphasis on customer service and the ability to teach people of all technical abilities. Practical experience applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Codex, Cursor) to real business problems, with enthusiasm for staying current on the fast-evolving AI landscape. Experience with Lean process improvement is a plus

For Denver based candidates, the compensation range for the position is expected to be between $82,000 and $100,000 annually. Total compensation, including base pay, discretionary individual bonus and company bonus, may be higher than range listed, depending on applicant’s skills, qualifications, and experience. Benefits include health insurance, life and disability insurance, 401k, EAP, paid holidays and paid time off.

About Chatham Financial

Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.

It’s clear ahead.

Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.

We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

jobs.description:
The Microsoft Configuration Management Administrator operates, monitors, and supports enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) while supporting the organization’s transition to Microsoft Intune and cloud-based endpoint management.

Performs day-to-day administration of application deployments, software updates, device collections, operating system deployment task sequences, configuration baselines, endpoint compliance, and vulnerability-remediation activities across enterprise Windows environments. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

This position investigates and resolves endpoint-management issues using Configuration Manager tools, reports, client logs, endpoint diagnostics, PowerShell, and established support procedures. Administrator executes approved changes, patch deployments, software releases, remediation actions, and configuration updates in accordance with change-management, cybersecurity, and operational requirements.

Works closely with senior engineers, architects, cloud teams, cybersecurity personnel, service desk teams, and system owners to sustain existing endpoint-management services and support the migration of appropriate workloads to Microsoft Intune and other cloud-based capabilities.

Administrator also maintains technical documentation, deployment records, operating procedures, and configuration information required to support service continuity, auditability, security compliance, and reliable operations.

Responsibilities

Administer and support Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including application deployment, software updates, device collections, task sequences, configuration baselines, inventory, reporting, and client troubleshooting.Package, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows applications across enterprise endpoints, including installation, detection, dependency, and removal requirements.Execute and monitor enterprise Windows patching and update deployments using software update groups, automatic deployment rules, maintenance windows, phased deployments, and compliance reporting.Support Windows operating system deployment and provisioning, including task sequences, PXE and boot media, driver management, imaging, application sequencing, and deployment troubleshooting.Create and maintain device collections, configuration items, and compliance baselines to support targeted deployments, detect configuration drift, measure compliance, and enable approved remediation.Troubleshoot endpoint-management issues using Configuration Manager logs, Event Viewer, CMPivot, console monitoring, client diagnostics, reporting tools, PowerShell, and related administrative utilities.Support Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, device registration, endpoint identity management, and related Windows device lifecycle activities.Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, implement security configurations, monitor compliance, and support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and related security controls.Support Microsoft Intune and co-management capabilities, including device enrollment, application deployment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, update rings, Windows Autopilot, and the phased migration of workloads from SCCM/MECM to cloud management.Use PowerShell and related scripting tools to automate routine endpoint-administration, reporting, remediation, and support activities while maintaining required change records, procedures, and technical documentation.

Qualifications

Active Secret security clearance.Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field. Significant and relevant endpoint-management, desktop engineering, or systems-administration experience may be considered as a substitute for a bachelor’s degree. Minimum of 3 years of experience administering enterprise Windows endpoint-management services, including SCCM/MECM, Intune, or a comparable endpoint-management platform. IAT Level II certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, or equivalent.Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or the ability to obtain the certification within 6 months of employment. Any clearance requirements for this position are established by the government contract.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate. Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert. Relevant Microsoft Azure, cybersecurity, IT service management, PowerShell, or systems-administration certifications.

2026-25998

Benefits

Regular - The company offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) and a range of other voluntary benefits. Paid Time Off (PTO) is offered to regular full-time and part-time employees.

Company Description

Work Where it Matters

Suvi, an Akima company, is not just another federal mission services contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At Suvi, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

For our shareholders, Suvi provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

For our government customers, Suvi delivers subject matter experts, an agile management approach, and innovative technologies that accomplish customers’ missions safely, securely, and efficiently.

As a Suvi employee, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

About Northern Essex Community College:

Northern Essex Community College (NECC) serves more than 5,000 students annually across its campuses in Haverhill and Lawrence, Massachusetts, conveniently located within easy reach of Boston and the scenic beaches and state parks of New England's coastline. Recognized as one of the 2026 Most Promising Places to Work in Community Colleges by NISOD (National Institute for Staff and Organizational Development), NECC's success is driven by a mission-centered culture and a highly engaged workforce. As the first federally designated Hispanic-Serving Institution in New England, NECC remains committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that reflects and supports the communities it serves.

Rooted in the Merrimack Valley, NECC plays a vital role in strengthening the region through workforce development, expanded access to affordable higher education, increased degree attainment, and strong partnerships with businesses.

NECC employees are united by a shared commitment expanding access to educational opportunities, supporting students in completing their academic journey in a timely and equitable manner, and preparing graduates for long-term success in the workforce. The college invests in its people through ongoing professional development opportunities, collaborative leadership, and a supportive work environment.

This position manages enterprise endpoint platforms with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune, modern device management, endpoint security, and backup and recovery systems, including backup URI administration.

The Endpoint Administrator works closely with infrastructure, security, service desk, and academic technology teams to ensure the reliable, secure, and compliant delivery of endpoint services for faculty, staff, and students.

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: Identity Management Windows Engineer
**TOP 3 SKILLS:** Microsoft 365, Identity Administration, Active Directory
LOCATION: San Jose, CA
DURATION: 12 mo+
RATE RANGE: $60-70/hour

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Identity Management Windows Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and support of the company's Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms and Microsoft enterprise collaboration services. Primary responsibilities include administration of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta Identity Cloud, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), identity governance, and Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams.
Secondary responsibilities include administration of Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, virtual server environments, backup and recovery systems, storage infrastructure, and disaster recovery solutions. The position provides technical leadership, operational support, and on-call response to ensure the security, reliability, and availability of critical business systems.

JOB DUTIES:
Identity & Access Management (Primary)

Administer Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta Identity Cloud, including user lifecycle management, access controls, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), identity governance, privileged access management, and authentication policies. Configure and maintain identity federation and directory integrations between Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and third-party applications using SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and SCIM. Implement and maintain identity security controls aligned with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies. Monitor identity, authentication, and access-related activity; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions to strengthen the organization's security posture. Lead IAM initiatives and projects including application onboarding, access modernization, authentication enhancements, and identity lifecycle automation. Microsoft 365 Administration (Primary) Administer and support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and related collaboration technologies. Manage Microsoft 365 security, compliance, mail flow, collaboration, and governance configurations. Support integration of Microsoft 365 services with Entra ID, Okta, and other enterprise applications. Monitor and optimize Microsoft 365 environments for availability, performance, security, and user experience. Azure Cloud Infrastructure Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure and hybrid cloud solutions including networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and connectivity services. Monitor and optimize cloud resources for performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency. Support cloud migrations, modernization initiatives, and infrastructure automation efforts. Server, Backup, Storage & Infrastructure (Secondary) Administer and support VMware and virtual server environments. Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Storage Area Network (SAN) infrastructure, backup systems, and recovery solutions. Support business continuity and disaster recovery initiatives, including Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, backup operations, recovery testing, and disaster recovery planning. Install, support, and maintain enterprise infrastructure, virtualization, networking, and security services. Monitor, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize server, storage, cloud, and supporting infrastructure systems. General Responsibilities Ensure accurate documentation of identity, Microsoft 365, cloud, server, and infrastructure configurations and procedures. Research emerging technologies and recommend security, identity, collaboration, and infrastructure enhancements. Lead and manage infrastructure projects of moderate complexity and scope. Ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), cybersecurity, and other regulatory requirements. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and operational guidance to Network Administrators and other IT staff. Participate in Continuous Improvement initiatives and perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

5+ years of experience administering enterprise identity management, Microsoft 365 services, and infrastructure platforms. Deep experience administering Active Directory (AD) and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Strong expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms, including hands-on administration of Okta Identity Cloud. Experience implementing and supporting Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions. Strong knowledge of identity governance, access controls, user lifecycle management, privileged access management, and directory services. Experience administering Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams. Ability to ensure the security, availability, and reliability of enterprise identity and collaboration platforms. Experience supporting Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments. Experience supporting virtual server environments, backup and recovery systems, storage infrastructure, and disaster recovery technologies. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Relevant Microsoft, Okta, Azure, and identity/security certifications preferred. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Valid California Driver License.

BENEFITS SUMMARY:
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate or annual salary only, unless otherwise stated. In addition to base compensation, full-time roles are eligible for Medical, Dental, Vision, Commuter and 401K benefits with company matching.

  Job Description:

  POSITION: Full-Time Endpoint Administrator (Staff Associate): Information Technology Client Computing; Haverhill Campus; 37.5 hours per week; Non-Unit Professional Position.

  SUMMARY: The Endpoint Administrator is responsible for the administration, support, and security of the College's endpoint computing environment. This position manages enterprise endpoint platforms with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune, modern device management, endpoint security, and backup and recovery systems, including backup URI administration.

  The Endpoint Administrator works closely with infrastructure, security, service desk, and academic technology teams to ensure the reliable, secure, and compliant delivery of endpoint services for faculty, staff, and students.

  RESPONSIBILITIES:

  The responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

   Administer and support endpoint management platforms with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune.
   Manage the full lifecycle of endpoint devices including provisioning, configuration, updates, compliance, and retirement.
   Design, implement, and maintain Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, and application deployments.
   Support endpoint environments across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.
   Configure and manage integrations between Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Defender, and other Microsoft 365 services.
   Implement and maintain conditional access and endpoint security policies in collaboration with IT Security.
   Monitor endpoint compliance, health, and reporting dashboards and remediate non-compliant devices.
   Troubleshoot complex endpoint issues escalated from the Service Desk.

Operating at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and business domain requirements, this role ensures seamless, governed data flows (\"Data as a Service\") between our primary Product Information Management platform (IPIM/Precisely/EnterWorks), Snowflake data warehouse, and downstream consumers (Salesforce, E-Commerce, Tableau). The ideal candidate combines hands-on SQL and data engineering principles with strong systems analysis experience to optimize the master data lifecycle and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data integration pipelines (APIs, ETL/ELT) connecting source systems (Mainframe, legacy SQL) to MDM/PIM platforms and Snowflake.Map data lineage, JSON/REST API payloads, and complex business transformation rules across enterprise boundaries to deliver clean, synchronized master data sets.Lead efforts to transition legacy, decentralized transformations (Alteryx, local SQL scripts) into optimized Snowflake cloud tables and automated orchestration workflows.Supervise and maintain structural data integrity, global taxonomy hierarchies, and attribute schemas within enterprise PIM/MDM platforms (e.g., Enter Works, Precisely or similar), enforcing automated validation rules and business logic.Write intermediate-to-advanced SQL queries and profiling scripts to perform automated data validation, backend regression testing, and anomaly detection across staging and production environments.Configure and manage outbound data syndication feeds to downstream enterprise applications, including Salesforce, e-commerce platforms, and reporting layers.Deconstruct complex business requirements, stakeholder asks, and domain rules into explicit technical specifications, system flow diagrams, and actionable Jira sprint tasks.Investigate and resolve high-priority data pipeline failures, sync gaps, and integration anomalies submitted via ITSM tools (Ivanti) and Jira, enforcing target SLAs.Evaluate downstream technical and reporting impacts prior to executing schema updates, taxonomy modifications, or API ingestion changes.Maintain detailed technical documentation, system flows, and data dictionaries in Confluence.Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software/Data Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).2–5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, integration engineering, or systems analysis within an enterprise MDM, PIM, or cloud data warehouse environment.Strong proficiency writing complex SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions) for database validation, pipeline profiling, and schema analysis.Hands-on experience with enterprise MDM/PIM platforms (EnterWorks, Informatica, or similar) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake).Solid understanding of APIs (REST/GraphQL, JSON/XML), ETL/ELT pipeline mechanics, and automated data orchestration.Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and service desk tools (Ivanti or similar) for managing sprint backlogs and incident tickets.Strong systems thinking and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge communications seamlessly between data engineering teams and non-technical business partners.

jobs.description:
Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai. Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees. Description Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers. THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED. JOB DUTIES: * Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting.
* Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates.
* Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans.
* Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M.
* Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves.
* Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment.
* Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation.
* Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval. REQUIREMENTS: * Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree).
* Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start; this is a Privileged User position.
* Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
* Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
* Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or CCNA-Security).
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or senior systems administration in an enterprise Windows environment.
* Hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM and/or Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), and PowerShell scripting.
* Experience developing engineering documentation (requirements, designs, test plans, change packages) and executing changes through formal Change Management.
* Experience applying DISA STIGs, working with ACAS/Nessus results, and supporting RMF control implementation and evidence collection.
* Understanding of IP networking, VDI, and endpoint security concepts sufficient to design and troubleshoot integrated solutions.
* Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.
  DESIRED SKILLS: * CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or CASP+ CE; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate; VMware VCP.
* Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.
* Experience building lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments for change validation and network modeling.
* Experience integrating AI/ML, RPA, or predictive analytics into IT operations, and familiarity with ServiceNow integrations and APIs.
* Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, DoDAF, and DoD ICAM Strategy.
* Experience with eMASS and RMF documentation.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: This position requires the ability to perform the below essential functions: * Sitting for long periods
* Standing for long periods
* Ambulate throughout an office
* Ambulate between several buildings

jobs.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Home Depot is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the IT Endpoint Engineering and Security team. This role develops, maintains, and supports enterprise endpoint infrastructure, platforms, and services across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

The Senior Systems Engineer will support technologies spanning endpoint management, patch management, software delivery, vulnerability remediation, endpoint security, configuration management, and automation. Relevant platforms may include Tanium, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Microsoft Intune, Broadcom Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar enterprise endpoint management and software distribution technologies.

This engineer will partner with architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations teams to continuously improve and mature endpoint services through strategic initiatives, automation, and operational improvements.

Senior Systems Engineers are expected to leverage enterprise tooling, scripting, automation, telemetry, and custom applications to monitor service health, optimize performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and improve the reliability and scalability of endpoint services.

The role may participate in an on-call rotation supporting routine upgrades, platform maintenance, application support, security remediation, root cause analysis, and post-mortem reviews related to service interruptions or security incidents.

The Senior Systems Engineer is expected to operate independently while also serving as a technical mentor to other engineers. Based on their experience,

Senior Engineers will help establish engineering standards, create and improve operational processes, lead technical initiatives, and ensure engineering and operational best practices are followed.

Required Qualifications

- 3–5 years of relevant engineering experience.

- Professional experience as a Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Security Engineer, or similar technical role.

- Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise endpoint management, patching, software delivery, or configuration management platforms such as Tanium, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Microsoft Intune, Broadcom Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar technologies.

- Experience deploying software, patches, configuration changes, and remediation actions across large endpoint or server environments.

- Experience monitoring and troubleshooting Windows, macOS, and/or Linux endpoints, including operating system configuration, application behavior, system performance, and connectivity.

- Experience troubleshooting endpoint-to-server and endpoint-to-cloud network communications.

- Experience supporting enterprise infrastructure and application services, including databases and supporting platform components.

- Experience with operating system command-line utilities and scripting or automation technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Bash/Shell scripting, or similar languages.

- Experience working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional engineering organization.

- Experience operating or delivering a production service and providing recommendations related to service strategy, architecture, reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to perform root cause analysis across complex enterprise environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, application deployment, software distribution, or endpoint configuration management at scale.

- Experience with endpoint management technologies such as Tanium, SCCM/MECM, Intune, Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar platforms.

- Experience with endpoint security technologies including Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), anti-malware, application control/allowlisting, file integrity monitoring, vulnerability management, or device management.

- Experience with endpoint security products such as CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Palo Alto Cortex, or similar technologies.

- Experience integrating vulnerability management and endpoint management platforms to automate identification and remediation of vulnerabilities.

- Experience managing physical and virtual infrastructure and troubleshooting network, systems, application, or security-related issues.

- Experience installing, upgrading, and maintaining enterprise applications, databases, or infrastructure platforms.

- Familiarity with systems architecture, environment analysis, and technical design.

- Familiarity with software troubleshooting tools, runtime analysis, application dependencies, software packaging, and software update technologies.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or AWS.

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments with thousands of endpoints or servers.

- Experience supporting highly available or 24x7 production environments, particularly retail or other distributed enterprise environments.

- Experience designing or implementing automation that reduces manual patching, software deployment, vulnerability remediation, or endpoint management processes.

Key Responsibilities:

- 100% Deliver Execution, Plans & Align, Problem Solving - Design automation workflows and capabilities in support of data collection, investigation and incident response Develop threat hunting and data analysis strategy and capabilities Identify and propose new technologies, methodologies and/or approaches to detecting malicious activity Utilize indicators to scope and respond proactively to emerging threats Design, build, configure, maintain and monitor cybersecurity threat defense capabilities and user access management

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

- This Position typically reports to Manager or Sr. Manager

- This Position has 0 Direct Reports

Travel Requirements:

- No travel required.

Physical Requirements:

- Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:

- Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

- Must be eighteen years of age or older.

- Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Minimum Education:

- The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

Minimum Years of Work Experience:

- 3+

Competencies:

- Action Oriented

- Collaborates

- Communicates Effectively

- Customer Focus

- Drives Results

 For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Nevada, New York City, Ithaca (NY), Westchester County (NY), and Washington residents:
The pay range for this position is between $120,000.00 - $160,000.00

jobs.description:
We love challenges. We love to build. We love to make things happen.

We love challenges. We love to build. We love to make things happen.
At JUSTROCKET , we're assembling the brightest minds to create exceptional teams and an ecosystem of like-minded and execution-oriented experts. Since 2016, we have been the heartbeat of the tech community in Cluj-Napoca.

About the project:

The partner we are hiring for is an IT service company based in Germany. Our partner builds and runs complex IT landscapes for clients in automotive, finance, and other regulated industries. Now they are strengthening their own corporate IT team and looking for someone who keeps identity, devices and tools running smoothly from the inside.

Some more interesting project facts

💡 You own identity and access for the whole company, not just a ticket queue

💡 Real production responsibility across Okta, Workspace ONE, Atlassian and more

💡 Automation is part of the job, not a side project

💡 International / cross-border team working closely together

💡 Security and compliance thinking from day one, ISO 27001 and TISAX are close by

💡 and many more – let's talk!

Aufgaben

We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer who is ready to run and shape the corporate IT of our partner, a fast-growing IT service company with projects in automotive, finance and other regulated industries.

As part of the Corporate IT team, you will keep identity, devices and tools running smoothly for the whole company.

Your activities will include:

⏩ Own identity and access management with Okta, covering SSO, MFA and the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding

⏩ Manage device fleets across MacBook, Windows and Android through Workspace ONE UEM, including enrollment, compliance and security policies
⏩ Keep the tool landscape in shape, Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Miro and the Atlassian suite, so colleagues actually enjoy using it
⏩ Build request types, workflows, SLAs and approval processes in Jira Service Management
⏩ Automate recurring work with Google Apps Script, Okta Workflows and n8n, so tasks run without manual clicking
⏩ Track CVEs across the fleet, review audit logs and set up automated security reporting, in line with GDPR and BDSG
⏩ Apply ISO 27001 and TISAX thinking to daily work, without owning the certifications themselves
⏩ Communicate clearly across the company, from technical detail for admins to the bigger picture for management

Qualifikation

You shall bring:

✅ Several years of hands on experience in corporate IT, IT operations or IT administration, ideally in a remote first environment
✅ Solid foundation across IAM (Okta or similar), collaboration suites (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365), MDM/UEM (Workspace ONE or similar) and Atlassian
✅ Scripting as everyday work, for example JavaScript, Apps Script, Python or low code workflows
✅ Security and compliance mindset from the outset, experience with ISO 27001 or TISAX is a big plus
✅ Strong communication skills in German (C1, native) and English (B2+), for documentation and vendor tickets
✅ Analytical and structured approach, you solve causes, not symptoms
✅ Ownership mentality, you drive your topics forward independently

 Nice to have
⏩ AWS integrations (API Gateway, Lambda), Looker Studio, ITIL knowledge or relevant certifications

 In case you are interested in the tech part, the general tool stack is

🖥 Okta (IAM)

🖥 Workspace ONE UEM

🖥 Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Miro
🖥 Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence)
🖥 Google Apps Script, Okta Workflows, n8n

🖥 AWS (API Gateway, Lambda)

Benefits

We provide

💪 Assistance in setting up the project/integrating with the team

💪 Guidance while onboarding

💪 Support in any aspect of your activities

💪 Free choice of hardware

💪 Perks like private health insurance and 7card

💪 Regular team events like a week in a mountain hut

💪 Hybrid work mode (we will empower a flexible hybrid mode forever)

💪 anything you are missing – let's talk!

Some final words

You will be joining a dynamic and cross-border project team in Cluj, working closely together with the partner in Germany.

If you have any further questions, feel free to contact us at any time!

Looking forward to meeting you for a (virtual) coffee or tea ☕️

jobs.description:
The Senior Microsoft Consultant will provide expertise across the Microsoft Modern Workplace stack of applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365 E5 productivity, security, and endpoint management capabilities.

The Senior Microsoft Consultant will provide expertise across the Microsoft Modern Workplace stack of applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365 E5 productivity, security, and endpoint management capabilities. This role is responsible for leading client-facing consulting engagements that span collaboration, device management, and security transformation.

This position requires the ability to architect, design, and implement Microsoft 365 solutions that balance user productivity, endpoint management, and enterprise security. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with both business and technical stakeholders while following the Coretek prescribed best practices approach to delivering projects in both commercial and CMMC environments.

Responsibilities

Design and implement Microsoft 365 E5 solutions, focusing on both productivity and security workloads according to Microsoft and Coretek best practices.

Productivity & Collaboration

- Design and implement enterprise collaboration solutions across Microsoft Teams (chat, meetings, lifecycle management, governance), SharePoint Online (Permissions, Access control, governance), OneDrive for Business (storage, sharing, lifecycle management), and Exchange Online (mail flow, protection, hybrid scenarios).

- Lead migration and modernization projects, including Exchange and file migrations to Microsoft 365 and tenant-to-tenant or hybrid transformations.

- Establish governance for collaboration, external sharing, and data lifecycle management.

- Drive improvements in user productivity, adoption, and collaboration effectiveness across client environments.

Endpoint Management & Intune

- Design and implement Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) solutions including device enrollment, provisioning, application deployment, and mobile application management.

- Configure device compliance policies, endpoint security controls, and Conditional Access integration with device state.

- Lead modern endpoint transformation initiatives including Windows Autopilot, co-management, and cloud-first device management strategies.

- Develop governance and standards for device management across enterprise clients.

Security & Compliance

- Implement Microsoft 365 E5 security solutions, including Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, Cloud Apps) and Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, eDiscovery, compliance management).

- Implement Zero Trust-aligned security controls and best practices across client environments.

- Develop and enhance security monitoring, policies, and automation.

- Assess client security infrastructure, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend Coretek services to address gaps.

Identity & Access Management

- Design and implement Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) solutions including Conditional Access, MFA, and identity lifecycle management.

- Implement authentication strategies and hybrid identity configurations including directory synchronization (AADC) and related components.

Delivery & Leadership

- Act as the technical lead on engagements, collaborating with architects and engineering teams on solution design and implementation.

- Establish, document, and communicate standards and best practices across M365 workloads in accordance with Coretek methodologies.

- Follow Coretek implementation plans and QC guides when working on projects, contributing feedback and continuous improvement to the process.

- Self-manage projects by escalating risks and issues while working within project scope and budget.

- Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.

- Provide training and knowledge transfer to client IT staff on Microsoft technologies and best practices.

- Stay current on Microsoft 365 roadmap across productivity, endpoint management, and security domains.

- Speak with clients to identify opportunities within their organization to address pain points where additional Coretek products and services can be leveraged.

Requirements

- 7+ years working in technology infrastructure design and deployment roles with a focus on Microsoft technologies.

- 3+ years of consulting or client-facing delivery experience (required).

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 productivity workloads (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange).

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM, Autopilot, endpoint compliance).

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft security solutions (Defender, Purview, Entra ID).

- Experience designing and implementing enterprise M365 solutions across multiple customer environments.

- Strong understanding of identity and access management concepts and cloud security principles.

- Relevant certifications such as MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert), MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), SC-100 or SC-200 (Security certifications) preferred.

- Experience with compliance frameworks (CMMC, NIST, ISO, HIPAA, PCI) is a plus.

- Experience with automation tools (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API) preferred.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with internal and external customers at all levels.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Must be a self-starter with excellent time management skills.

jobs.summary: ****Descripción del Puesto:**** En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones...
jobs.description:
****Descripción del Puesto:**** En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones de usuario final; excluye Advanced Solutions). Tendrás a cargo una cartera definida de partners y cuentas clave, con foco en maximizar ingresos, rentabilidad y nuevas líneas de negocio. Serás un referente para nuestros socios del canal, impulsando planificación de cuentas, generación de pipeline, gestión de licitaciones y adopción de nuestras plataformas digitales.

****Lo que harás:****

* Desarrollar y hacer crecer la cartera de partners: planificación de cuenta, mapeo de decisores, detección de oportunidades y activación de campañas.
* Ser una persona de confianza para los clientes, manteniendo relaciones estratégicas con visitas presenciales periódicas.
* Diseñar y ejecutar planes estratégicos para impulsar el negocio actual y el crecimiento incremental.
* Identificar, registrar y hacer seguimiento de oportunidades (pipeline) asegurando la calidad del funnel y el cumplimiento de metas.
* Coordinar recursos internos y liderar la interacción con Inside Sales, Operaciones de Venta y las Unidades de Negocio Especialistas (SBUs).
* Identificar oportunidades/proyectos conjuntamente con los BDM y equipos de Vendor Management.
* Relevar requerimientos del cliente y elaborar propuestas que agreguen valor, protegiendo el margen y el mix de productos/soluciones.
* Gestionar licitaciones y concursos (sector público y privado), coordinando inventario, plazos y documentación.
* Monitorear inventario y forecast, articulando con operaciones y vendors para asegurar disponibilidad y niveles de servicio.
* Detectar necesidades y problemas del cliente, resolviéndolos o escalándolos a las áreas correspondientes.
* Obtener insights mediante el perfilado y análisis de la cartera, generando acciones para maximizar oportunidades y expandir la base de partners.
* Completar en tiempo y forma el reporte y la administración en los sistemas de TD SYNNEX (CRM, reportes, profiling).
* Impulsar el uso de la plataforma de e‑commerce de TD SYNNEX (InTouch), promoviendo sus beneficios y aumentando la adopción.
* Mantener y mejorar los acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLAs) con clientes y áreas internas.
* Operar bajo las mejores prácticas, políticas y objetivos de TD SYNNEX, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y ético.

**Lo que buscamos**

* 3 años de experiencia relevante en ventas B2B o gestión de cuentas en la industria de tecnología (mayorista, fabricante u OEM, o reseller), preferentemente en categorías de Endpoint (computación personal, impresión, periféricos, colaboración).
* Red de relaciones y cartera activa en el canal de Argentina, con historial comprobable de desarrollo de partners y crecimiento de cuentas.
* Experiencia multimarca y trabajo con vendors/OEMs; capacidad para priorizar y balancear portafolio protegiendo margen.
* Sólida gestión de pipeline, pronóstico, negociación y cierre; dominio de CRM (ideal Salesforce) y Excel/herramientas de análisis.
* Experiencia en gestión de licitaciones y concursos, deseable con conocimiento del sector público.
* Enfoque a resultados, autonomía, capacidad de influencia sin autoridad formal y colaboración transversal.
* Habilidad para trabajo en campo con viajes frecuentes dentro del país.
* Inglés intermedio/avanzado para interactuar con equipos regionales y materiales de vendors.

**Será un plus**

* Experiencia previa en mayoristas o vendors líderes de Endpoint
* Haber impulsado adopción de plataformas de e‑commerce B2B; conocimiento previo de InTouch.

****Las condiciones de trabajo:****

* Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido).
* Horas de trabajo no estándar, según lo requiera el negocio.

Tú qué sacas de esto?

* **Aprovecha al máximo nuestra Organización Global:**establece contactos con otros nuevos compañeros de trabajo dentro de sus primeros 30 días a través de nuestro programa de incorporación.
* **Haz crecer tu carrera:**nuestra primera prioridad es contratar internamente y ayudar a nuestra gente a crecer. Como compañero de trabajo, tendrás más oportunidades profesionales disponibles. También puedes acelerar su camino hacia el éxito con programas formales sobre liderazgo y desarrollo profesional, y muchos más cursos a pedido.
* **Trabaja con proveedores de clase mundial:**nuestros representantes de televentas actuales están trabajando con algunas de las marcas más importantes en tecnología.
* **Eleva tu bienestar personal:**aumenta tu bienestar financiero, físico y mental a través de seminarios, eventos y nuestro Programa global de asistencia para el empoderamiento de la vida (LEAP por sus siglas en Inglés).
* **Diversidad, equidad e inclusión:** no es solo una frase para nosotros; valorando cada voz es cómo tenemos éxito. Únete a nosotros para celebrar nuestra diversidad global a través de educación inclusiva, conversaciones significativas entre pares y oportunidades equitativas de crecimiento y desarrollo.

¿No cumples con todos los requisitos? Aplica de todos modos:

En TD SYNNEX, estamos orgullosos de ser reconocidos como un excelente lugar para trabajar y líder en la promoción y práctica de la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.

Si está entusiasmado por trabajar para nuestra empresa y cree que es un buen candidato para este puesto, lo alentamos a que presente su solicitud.

¡Puedes ser exactamente la persona que estamos buscando!

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

**What's In It For You?**

* **Elective Benefits:** Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* **Grow Your Career:**Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* **Elevate Your Personal Well-Being:** Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* **Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion:**It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* **Make the Most of our Global Organization**: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* **Connect with Your Community:** Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones/Sistemas/Computación/Afín.

jobs.description:
¡Buscamos Administrador de Endpoint MDM (Microsoft Intune)!

Ubicación: Santa Fe, Alcaldía Álvaro Obregón, CDMX (Modo Híbrido)

Inglés: Técnico conversacional

¿Cuál será tu reto principal?

Llevar a cabo la administración integral del ciclo de vida de los dispositivos de la compañía, garantizando la seguridad, el cumplimiento de políticas y la entrega eficiente de software a través de Microsoft Intune.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

**Habilidades Técnicas Clave** Gestión de Intune \& Identidades: Administración de identidades híbridas, licencias, grupos y perfiles de configuración/cumplimiento (Compliance).

Control de Acceso \& Seguridad: Configuración de Acceso Condicional y MFA.

Sistemas Operativos: Experiencia multiplataforma en Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS/iPadOS y Android.

Empaquetado y Despliegue: Manejo de software en formatos .msi, .exe, .intunewin, Apple VPP, Google Play Corporativo y Windows Store.

Automatización: Uso de PowerShell y Microsoft Graph API para optimizar procesos y generación de reportes.

**Competencias y Habilidades Blandas** Diagnóstico y Troubleshooting: Capacidad para análisis e interpretación de logs de fallos en políticas y despliegues.

Comunicación Eficiente: Soporte a usuarios finales y transferencia de conocimiento a Mesa de Ayuda (Niveles 1 y 2).

Actitud y Compromiso: Organización, honestidad, alto sentido de urgencia, resolución de problemas bajo presión y disponibilidad para atender incidencias fuera de horario comercial.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Excelente ambiente de trabajo y proyectos de alto impacto tecnológico.

Contratación e incorporación inmediata.

¿Interesado/a o conoces a alguien ideal?

Envía tu CV actualizado a \[rh@dti.com.mx\] con el subject subject INTUNE o postúlate directamente por este medio.
