jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.
 About Onebrief
Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Today, many critical planning workflows still rely on fragmented systems, static documents, and disconnected tools that make collaboration and decision-making unnecessarily difficult. Onebrief brings modern software, AI, and real-time collaboration into those environments, helping teams operate with greater clarity, coordination, and adaptability in situations where decisions carry real-world consequences.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

 About the Role Onebriefs infrastructure team owns the platform that delivers our software to military staffs. Our charter spans Kubernetes clusters in commercial and government cloud, application streaming for thin-client users on classified networks, a unified artifact pipeline that signs and ships the same builds to every environment we operate, and air-gapped appliances at forward sites.
Were hiring an Infrastructure Engineer who builds security into the systems they operate rather than treating it as a separate workstream. Youll architect, build, and run the platform end to end. This includes RFCs, PRDs, and reviewing and writing production code alongside Product and Engineering teammates.

The work cuts across cloud-native deployments, edge appliances, data platforms, and the application streaming layer that puts Onebrief on classified environments. Youll partner with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) and mission owners on STIGs, CVE remediation, audit prep, and the controls work that lets us operate in environments such as IL5, IL6, and JWICS.

Success means a platform that stays up under real operational load, ships trusted artifacts to every profile we run, and passes audits without fire drills.

 About You People by-name request you because you bias towards action. You are a problem-solver by nature who genuinely cares about the mission and the outcome. You operate without hand-holding. You read a problem, weigh tradeoffs, and move. Sometimes the tradeoffs have harsh consequences that you pay for later, but you are resilient and adapt. When the work crosses into expertise you dont have, you dig into the problem, pull in the right teammates, apply their feedback, and continue.
 What Youll Do Design, develop, test, iterate, and deploy secure production systems across cloud-native and edge appliance deployments

Embed with cross-functional teams and advise on infrastructure, security, and deployment best practices that hold up in production

Own end-to-end infrastructure outcomes for one or more critical programs or priority infrastructure initiatives

Harden the artifact pipeline so the same signed builds run in cloud, single-tenant high-side, and air-gapped appliance deployments

 What We Look For Youll do well in this role if you bring:
8+ years operating production infrastructure in DevOps/DevSecOps, Platform, SRE, Cloud, or Infrastructure role

Full-stack engineering experience when necessary, e.g., production experience designing, building, and operating services in a modern backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Rust, TypeScript)

Deep production Kubernetes experience: operators, networking, storage, multi-cluster operations, and a feel for what breaks at scale

Expertise with major cloud providers (e.g., Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure), with strong instincts for designing across providers and profiles

Strong application and infrastructure security fundamentals: identity, network segmentation, secrets management, common vulnerability classes, and sound security judgment under ambiguity

Demonstrated ability to build working solutions from scratch, connect disparate applications together, and jump into existing code bases to add value

Experience packaging and shipping workloads into disconnected or air-gapped environments

Demonstrated leadership/mentorship experience

Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance

 Nice to have qualifications :
Active US SECRET or TOP SECRET security clearance

Government cloud expertise (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government)

FedRAMP, IL4/IL5, IL6, or JWICS environment exposure

Audit experience (FedRAMP, SOC 2, or equivalent)

Big data and distributed data experience

Prior experience supporting defense, intelligence, or other regulated industries

Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency.

Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.description:
About HeliusHelius is a leading developer platform on the Solana blockchain, dedicated to inspiring and accelerating the creation of crypto-powered software. Customers like Coinbase, Jupiter, and Phantom use Helius to power their applications on Solana.

We’ve raised over $34m from Haun Ventures, Founders Fund, Foundation Capital, 6th Man Ventures, Reciprocal Ventures, Chapter One and angel investors including Solana co-founders Anatoly Yakovenko and Raj Gokal, and Balaji Srinivasan. Our team members have previously built mission-critical, scalable infrastructure at AWS, Coinbase, Stripe, Google, Digital Ocean, and more.

Read our Helius Manifesto to see how we work and what we value.

About the RoleHelius runs its global edge network and high-performance services directly on bare metal. It's a deliberate choice for performance and cost, and it means the machines, the network, and the tooling that ties them together are ours to get right. This role joins our Platform team to make that fleet faster to provision, safer to access, cheaper to run, and boring to deploy to.

You'll work across the foundation everything else at Helius depends on: automating how servers get spun up and configured, standardizing how software gets built and shipped to machines, and executing on our engineering security roadmap. This is an intermediate role with a lot of room to grow. We care more about ownership, intensity, and learning speed than about a perfect match on today's stack.

No crypto background is needed. If you've run serious infrastructure anywhere, we'll teach you the blockchain parts.

What You'll DoAutomate the server lifecycle end to end: provisioning, OS installs, configuration, hardware validation, and decommissioning

Build and maintain the tooling engineers use to interact with the fleet, so nobody hand-configures a machine twice

Standardize how we build and deploy software to machines: CI pipelines, artifacts, deploy tooling, and rollbacks

Execute security roadmap items alongside our security lead: SSO-integrated access, jump hosts, secrets management, least-privilege access, and audit trails

Run cost analysis across the fleet, including cost per workload, provider comparisons, and hardware refresh decisions, and turn it into recommendations

Improve observability for the infrastructure you own, and take part in on-call and incident response

Write clear runbooks and docs so the rest of a remote team can operate what you build

What We're Looking ForExtreme ownership: you treat the systems you touch as yours, see problems through to the fix, and automate yourself out of repetitive work rather than living with it. You work the way our Manifesto describes (fast, direct, low-ego, and accountable), and that matters to us more than any single item below.

3+ years in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering

Hands-on bare metal experience, such as provisioning and managing physical servers (PXE, IPMI/BMC, RAID, NICs), working with colo or dedicated-server providers, and debugging hardware versus software issues

Deep Linux fundamentals, including systemd, networking, storage, and performance tuning

Experience with configuration management and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Ansible, Terraform, Salt, Nix)

Solid scripting or programming ability in Python, Go, Bash, or similar

A security mindset: you think about access, blast radius, and secrets by default, not as an afterthought

Nice to Have Rust experience, or interest in reading and debugging Rust services

High-performance networking or low-latency systems experience

Familiarity with ClickHouse, Prometheus, or Grafana

Experience at a high-scale B2B infrastructure company

Why Helius?High-impact work: Your code will power applications used by millions across the Solana ecosystem, including Coinbase, Jupiter, and Phantom.

Serious engineering: Build fast, reliable systems and user experiences across distributed infra, high-throughput backends, and modern frontend stacks.

Ownership & growth: Lead critical initiatives, influence architecture and product direction, and take on more responsibility as the company scales.

Remote-first flexibility: Work where you’re most effective with a flexible, fully distributed team.

Competitive comp & perks: Market-leading salary, meaningful equity, generous vacation, wellness budgets, and support for learning and travel.

Mission-driven team: Join ambitious builders who move fast, take ownership, and are shaping the future of decentralized apps.

jobs.description:
Overview

About Us

Working across the globe, V2X builds smart solutions designed to integrate physical and digital infrastructure from base to battlefield. We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $4.5B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

The AI-Ready Endpoint & MDM Engineer is a technical role responsible for the evaluation, operation, maintenance, security, and evolution of the global endpoint environment. Reporting to the Director of AI-Ready Endpoint Infrastructure & Security, this engineer will utilize agentic AI and modern configuration management to automate the administration of the company's unified endpoint ecosystem. This role provides engineering and development across multiple Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms (Intune, Jamf, Google MDM, Automox) and cloud workspace solutions, including Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) managed via Nerdio. The engineer ensures all endpoints are hardened, compliant, and continuously prepared to serve as secure platforms for both human users and AI workloads, while applying FinOps principles to optimize cloud performance and financial efficiency.Key Responsibilities

Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) & Cloud Workspace ManagementArchitect, deploy, and manage Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments purpose-built to support multiple user personas, tailoring compute, storage, and application delivery to distinct organizational roles and workload requirements.Utilize Nerdio Manager for Enterprise to centrally manage AVD deployments, automate image staging, and streamline the provisioning of Windows cloud desktops and remote applications.Maintain operating efficiency and stability for remote desktop services and Azure VDI Desktops, ensuring secure, high-performance remote access.FinOps & Infrastructure Cost OptimizationImplement FinOps best practices by leveraging Nerdio's advanced auto-scaling capabilities to dynamically adjust active session host VMs based on real-time user demand, significantly reducing monthly Azure compute and storage costs.Balance infrastructure cost optimization with a seamless user experience by configuring hybrid auto-scaling strategies that combine proactive schedule-based scaling (pre-warming capacity) with reactive performance-based scaling (CPU/memory triggers).Optimize storage expenditures by automating OS disk downgrades for non-persistent machines during idle periods and utilizing "Start on Connect" logic for personal 1:1 assigned desktops.Unified Endpoint & MDM EngineeringDevelop, deploy, and maintain management software and systems across a diverse global fleet of endpoints, including Windows 11 PCs, MacBooks, Chromebooks, Windows Servers, RHEL servers, Android, and iOS devices.Configure and optimize enterprise MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Google MDM, and Automox) to enforce configuration baselines and compliance policies.Manage Operating System Deployment (OSD) task sequences, OS images, and automated software packaging pipelines for complex, multi-platform environments.Agentic AI, Automation & Patch ManagementLeverage agentic AI workflows to automate device lifecycle management, from zero-touch provisioning and onboarding to offboarding and secure decommission.Integrate intelligent agents to monitor endpoint health, interpret compliance data, and execute self-healing remediations autonomously across the MDM infrastructure.Manage the testing and deployment of third-party patching, as well as workstation and server security, feature, and quality updates across all operating systems.Governance & SupportGather information and implement policies required for legal and regulatory compliance, such as CMMC Level 2 and NIST 800-171 controls.Prioritize and respond to requests for service, providing Tier 3 escalation support and guidance to global endpoint support staff in remote locations.Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's Degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained. (One year related experience may be substituted for one year of education, if degree is required)

Experience:

Minimum of 4 to 6 years of related IT experience, with at least 3 years focused specifically on endpoint systems administration, MDM platform management, and cloud virtualization.

Other Requirements:

U.S. Citizenship required.

Required Skills & Competencies:

Hands-on administrative expertise across multiple UEM/MDM platforms, specifically Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Google MDM, and Automox.

Deep proficiency in cross-platform operating system management, including Windows 11, macOS, ChromeOS, Windows Server, RHEL, iOS, and Android.

Expertise in designing and managing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments optimized for multiple personas and workloads.

Strong understanding of cloud FinOps principles and hands-on experience using Nerdio Manager for Enterprise for automated scaling, cost optimization, and dynamic resource provisioning.

Familiarity with extending configuration management and Zero Trust device posture checks to monitor and govern AI agents running on endpoints.

Proficiency in scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash, Python) and utilizing APIs to integrate platforms.

What We Bring

At V2X we strive to be market competitive in our total reward offerings.

The successful candidate's starting pay will be based on, but not limited to, their job related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.

USD $ 130,000 - 190,000

Provided salary range minimum and maximum values correspond to variances between regional/geographic locations across the United States.

Please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Employee benefits include the following:

Healthcare coverage

Retirement plan

Life insurance, AD&D, and disability benefits

Wellness programs

Paid time off, including holidays

Learning and Development resources

Employee assistance resources

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time and may be modified at the discretion of the company, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

We ensure all individuals are treated with fairness, respect, and dignity, recognizing the strength that comes from a workforce rich in diverse experiences, perspectives, and skills. This commitment, aligned with our core Vision and Values of Integrity, Respect, and Responsibility, allows us to leverage differences, encourage innovation, and expand our success in the global marketplace, ultimately enabling us to best serve our clients.

jobs.summary: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of...
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SR. IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR (TOP SECRET CLEARANCE)

SpaceX is looking for a Sr. Systems Administrator with deep knowledge and broad experience across Microsoft-based technologies, in addition to broader experience and capability with networking and Linux technologies. This employee will be a member of the Information Technology team and will support SpaceX personnel and systems. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast paced and challenging environment. He or she should be a self-starter, self-motivator and possess ingenuity to excel at this position.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Work closely with other SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support enterprise software platforms and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Build highly-resilient, high-performance, scalable, and flexible systems.

- Take lessons learned and technology standards from the SpaceX Enterprise and apply them in smaller air-gapped environments.

- Exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species.

- Make recommendations, justify, and implement improvements using an accepted change control methodology.

- Work within a diverse group to design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner by interacting with internal business units.

- Define, document and follow standards and best practices for systems design, testing, and implementation.

- Drive scripting and automation to develop solutions to common problems.

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 4+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Experience with Windows servers in physical and virtualized enterprise level environments.

- Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos, and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with networking technologies and the Linux operating system environment.

- PowerShell scripting experience.

- Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting classified networks.

- Working knowledge of Windows-based systems and services, including the ability to set up, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot.

- Expert working knowledge (including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot) Windows-based systems and services such as DHCP, DNS, IIS, MS-SQL, NPS, etc.

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identity environments

- Experience with Enterprise Microsoft Exchange and SharePoint deployments.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Hands-on experience with Windows Server 2012/2016 (AD, DNS, DHCP, etc.)

- Experience in IPv4, switching, routing, firewalls and HA architecture.

- Must be comfortable working with mission critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Active Top Secret or TS/SCI with Polygraph. Note that an active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions. If so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.

- Willing to work after-hour on-call rotations, extended hours, and weekends when needed.

- Must be willing to do some travel domestically (<10%) in the future as needed.

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $150,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SR. IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, MISSION SYSTEMS

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and versatile Launch Sr. IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role is critical to enabling safe, reliable, and high-cadence launch operations across multiple sites. The ideal candidate thrives in mission-critical settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and is comfortable operating as a technical generalist across multiple IT disciplines.

   RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, deploy and augment IT infrastructure including networking, server, and desktop hardware that directly supports mission-critical networks across the country.

- Provide direct IT support during launch and test campaigns.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and maintenance in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Proactively monitor IT services and respond rapidly to incidents to ensure high availability and optimal systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, including systems overview, design drawings and operational procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to broader IT systems engineering and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 5+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Experience with both Linux and Windows server administration.

- Experience designing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting enterprise networks.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc.), firewall administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identity environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge of Windows-based systems and services, including the ability to set up, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot said infrastructure.

- Ability to administer and troubleshoot Linux-based systems and services through command line.

- Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps concepts/tools.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass DoD background check for launch site access.

- Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

Position Summary

The Endpoint Administrator II is responsible for the deployment, configuration, management, and security of endpoint devices across the CallTower organization. This role focuses on Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, Windows and macOS device management, and modern endpoint administration practices.

As a member of the Endpoint team, this individual will help manage the full device lifecycle, including provisioning, enrollment, compliance, application deployment, security configuration, patch management, and user support for corporate endpoints. The Endpoint Administrator II will also assist with endpoint security initiatives, automation, and continuous improvement of device management processes.

Position Responsibilities

Configure, deploy, and manage Windows and macOS devices using Microsoft Intune.Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including group management, device identities, Conditional Access, and authentication-related services.Manage endpoint enrollment and provisioning processes, including Windows Autopilot and Apple device enrollment.Deploy, configure, and maintain device compliance policies, configuration profiles, and security baselines.Administer Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and participate in endpoint security initiatives.Manage mobile device and application management (MDM/MAM) policies for corporate and BYOD environments.Deploy and maintain software packages, updates, and operating system upgrades through Intune.Monitor endpoint health, compliance, inventory, and security status through management platforms and reporting solutions.Troubleshoot device management, enrollment, authentication, compliance, and application deployment issues.Create and maintain documentation for endpoint management processes, procedures, and standards.Participate in endpoint-related projects, migrations, upgrades, and technology rollouts.Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and support teams to ensure a secure and reliable endpoint experience.Maintain asset inventory accuracy and support device lifecycle processes including onboarding, refreshes, and offboarding.

jobs.description:
About Agile Defense

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Location: Redstone Arsenal, Alabama

Work Type: Full-Time, On-Site

Clearance Requirement: Active DoD Secret clearance required to start

Certification Requirement: DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE)

Position Summary:

The Endpoint Systems Administrator serves as the technical liaison between the Enterprise Patch Management team and Customer Support Technicians. This hands-on technical role drives the identification, tracking, and remediation of Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS) vulnerability findings while supporting endpoint version control and software compliance efforts.

The successful candidate will bridge patching strategy and frontline execution to ensure vulnerabilities are communicated, addressed, documented, and closed efficiently across the enterprise environment. This is an IAT-track technical position, not an IAM role.

Key Responsibilities

Hunt, triage, and drive remediation of ACAS vulnerability findings across managed endpoints.

Coordinate with the Enterprise Patch Management team to align remediation timelines with established patch cycles.

Serve as the primary liaison between the Patch Management team and Customer Support Technicians for findings requiring local or hands-on action.

Support endpoint version control and software compliance using Tanium or equivalent endpoint-management tools.

Troubleshoot and resolve one-off, nonstandard endpoint issues outside routine patching and vulnerability-remediation workflows.

Track vulnerability status, document remediation actions, and report aging or at-risk findings.

Communicate directly with customers and support technicians to clarify findings, gather system context, and confirm remediation.

Escalate systemic patching, configuration, or compliance gaps to leadership with supporting data.

Support continuous improvement of endpoint vulnerability-management and patch-compliance processes.

Required Qualifications

Two to four years of experience in endpoint systems administration, vulnerability management, or a related information technology role.

Active DoD Secret security clearance.

DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE.

Working knowledge of vulnerability-scanning and remediation workflows, including ACAS, Nessus, or similar tools.

Solid understanding of patch management concepts, endpoint configuration, and compliance practices.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work directly with customers and technical support personnel.

Ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams with differing priorities and responsibilities.

Ability to work on-site at Redstone Arsenal, Alabama.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Tanium, including Comply, Deploy, Patch, or Connect modules.

Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex, nonrepeatable endpoint issues rather than relying solely on documented remediation playbooks.

Familiarity with DoD or federal compliance frameworks, including Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and ACAS reporting standards.

Experience supporting customers in a matrixed, enterprise, or customer-facing IT environment.

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.

What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.

Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.

Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.

Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.

Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.

Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.

Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

jobs.description:
Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

Key Responsibilities:

 Operational Support:Provide 4th level support for incidents and requests related to endpoint health, including on-call work when required. Ticket Management:Monitor and handle tickets assigned to your support queues and be available to support any related major incidents. Product Expertise:Develop a deep understanding of the endpoint protection products you will be managing. Documentation:Create and maintain knowledge base documents and playbooks outlining end-to-end support procedures and inter-team workflows. Change Management:Support change management activities for product upgrades within the production environment, collaborating with in-house teams and third parties to ensure successful implementation. Escalation Response:Respond to escalations from Security Policy Management, GNOC, SOC, and Member Firms, assisting them with understanding endpoint protection products and support processes. Testing and Ad-Hoc Duties:Assist the technical lead/architect and security analyst in testing product upgrades and perform other job-related duties as assigned.

The team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

 Strong multi-tasker with a keen eye for detail and the ability to think ahead. Experience with configuration and deployment of endpoint protection platforms (e.g., CrowdStrike, McAfee, Microsoft, admin rights management). Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, strong influence, and negotiation skills. Strong written and verbal communication and customer service skills. Creative and independent thinker with the ability to translate technical requirements and challenges into results. Knowledge of configuration, policy, and event workflows and playbooks. Motivated self-starter able to work independently without direct supervision. Well-organized and able to thrive in fast-paced environments. Direct experience in supporting security tools (e.g., anti-virus, host intrusion detection). Experience working within a service management framework (e.g., ITIL). Knowledge of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools. Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

The Senior Endpoint Management Engineer provides a centralized reporting and problem resolution Program to support users of Information Technology; Manage University IT best practices with Industry best practices within the structure of IT Service
Management.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information technologies, or equivalent experience.

Expertise in IIS and web application development.

jobs.description:
🔹 **Senior Software Packager -- SCCM / Intune** 🔹

📌 About the role

We are looking for a **Senior Software Packager** to join an international **Application Delivery** environment.

In this role, you will manage **software packaging requests end-to-end** , from initial analysis and **package creation** through **testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and post-implementation support**.

You will work in a highly technical enterprise environment, **creating software packages from scratch** and ensuring **quality, traceability, compatibility, and compliance** with internal standards.

The role involves close collaboration with technical and business teams, as well as hands-on work with **packaging technologies, scripting, software distribution platforms, and automation**.

If you have strong experience with **MSI, MSIX, Intunewin, SCCM, Intune, PowerShell, PSADT**, and enterprise software packaging, this could be a great fit.

💻 What you'll do

🔹 Manage **software packaging requests end-to-end**: registration, analysis, package creation, testing, delivery, deployment, and post-implementation support

🔹 **Create, customise, and maintain software packages from scratch** using technologies such as **MSI, MSIX, Intunewin**, and similar

🔹 Use packaging and troubleshooting tools such as **Orca**

🔹 Manage software distribution and deployment to corporate devices using **Microsoft SCCM and Intune**

🔹 Develop and maintain **automation scripts** using **PowerShell, PSADT, Ansible**, or similar technologies

🔹 Analyse packaging requirements and define the most appropriate **technical solution**

🔹 Test packages across **enterprise environments** and ensure compatibility with corporate standards

🔹 Troubleshoot complex packaging and deployment issues and provide **Level 3 support**

🔹 Coordinate with **IT teams, business stakeholders, and internal customers** to prioritise and manage multiple requests

🔹 Document packaging processes, technical solutions, incidents, and troubleshooting procedures

🔹 Monitor **SLAs** and provide regular reporting on packaging requests and incidents

🔹 Identify opportunities to improve and **automate packaging workflows**

🔹 Participate in cross-functional projects related to **Application Delivery** and software distribution

💡 Must Have

🔹 **5+ years of experience** in **Software Packaging / Application Packaging** within enterprise environments

🔹 Strong hands-on experience **creating software packages from scratch**, not only modifying existing templates

🔹 Advanced knowledge of **MSI, MSIX, Intunewin**, or similar packaging formats

🔹 Experience with packaging tools such as **Orca**

🔹 Strong experience with **Microsoft SCCM and Intune** for software distribution and deployment

🔹 Strong scripting skills, particularly **PowerShell and PSADT**

🔹 Experience with **Ansible** or similar automation technologies

🔹 Solid understanding of the **complete software packaging lifecycle**, from request analysis through deployment and post-production support

🔹 Experience troubleshooting complex **packaging and deployment issues**

🔹 Experience working with **Agile, ITIL**, or similar service management methodologies

🔹 Strong **communication skills** and ability to interact with both technical and business stakeholders

🔹 Ability to manage **multiple packaging requests and priorities simultaneously**

🔹 **Customer-oriented mindset** and strong focus on **continuous improvement**

🔹 **Fluent English** , ideally **C1 level or above**

🔹 Professional working proficiency in **Spanish**

✨ Nice to Have

🔹 Experience **automating software packaging and deployment processes**

🔹 Experience integrating **packaging workflows** with other enterprise systems

🔹 Knowledge of **networking concepts**

🔹 Knowledge of databases such as **SQL or MongoDB**

🔹 Familiarity with **software development concepts and API management**

🔹 Degree in **Computer Engineering, Computer Science**, or a related technical field

🔹 Previous experience in **large-scale international enterprise environments**

🏢 **Hybrid model -- 2 days onsite per week**

🌍 Why join this project?

🤝 People first -- diverse and inclusive culture in an **international environment**.

🚀 Work on **enterprise-scale software packaging** and **Application Delivery** projects

💻 Take ownership of the **full packaging lifecycle**, from requirement analysis to deployment and support

⚙️ Work with **SCCM, Intune, PowerShell, PSADT, MSI, MSIX** , and modern **automation technologies**

🤖 Contribute to the evolution and **automation of software packaging processes**

🌍 Collaborate with **international technical and business teams**

📈 Join a stable project where **technical expertise, ownership, and continuous improvement** are highly valued

😁 High team stability and collaborative culture.

🎓 €1200 per year training budget and continuous learning opportunities.

💰 Flexible compensation model.

🩺 Private health insurance and benefits package.

⚡ Flexible working hours and hybrid model.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a dedicated Endpoint Engineer to join our client's technology team as an embedded, full-time engineering resource. This role was created to relieve an endpoint team operating at full capacity and to drive platform optimization, automation, and documentation modernization across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

* Endpoint Device Management: Administer and optimize Intune (Microsoft) and Kandji (Apple) across the full device fleet
* Microsoft 365 Optimization: Manage and optimize the M365 environment including licensing, policies, and platform governance
* Collaboration Platform Administration: Administer Box, Slack, and Zoom environments
* Automation \& Tooling: Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation initiatives to reduce manual workload
* Documentation: Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, and architecture documentation; close gaps left by legacy Managed Service Provider environments
* Platform Governance: Mature operational processes and platform governance
* After-Hours Support: Participate in after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage rotation to reduce burden on internal engineers
* Onboarding \& Standards: Establish and enforce endpoint build standards and configuration baselines

* Minimum 7 years of practical, hands-on experience supporting and administering enterprise endpoints, including endpoint management, desktop engineering, technical support, device provisioning, software deployment, patch management, and workplace technology services
* Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and -preferably- Kandji MDM platforms
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 administration and optimization
* Working knowledge in Cisco Meraki and foundational networking concepts
* Experience with collaboration tools: Box, Slack, Zoom, Jira
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation
* Experience creating technical documentation and runbooks
* Ability to work independently as an embedded team member
* Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
* Ability to travel to the United States approximately 10% of the time
* Knowledge of AI capabilities and practical business applications is a plus

jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is where millions of people hang out every day - 90% of them play games, spending over 5 billion hours across thousands of titles each month. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Client Platform Data Science team, where you’ll help make sure that Discord just works. You’ll partner with the teams that design, build, and support Discord - improving app performance, enhancing the user experience, and driving growth. Your work will span strategic analyses, experimentation, and dashboarding. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can help us take Discord’s mobile and desktop reliability to the next level through better metrics, monitoring, and automation.

If you’re passionate about data and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

 What you'll be doing

- Partner with teams throughout Discord through the full analytics lifecycle - from exploratory analyses to dashboards, reports, and A/B testing

- Define KPIs and diagnostic metrics that improve the user experience, and build dashboards to make them timely and actionable

- Build custom datasets to monitor novel product features and processes

- Share insights with technical and non-technical audiences, and iterate based on feedback

- Champion A/B testing best practices - helping teams design, analyze, and interpret experiments correctly

- Collaborate with data and engineering teams to design scalable and future-proof instrumentation and self-serve tooling

 What you should have

- 2+ years of hands-on analytics experience turning ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable insights

- Experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting A/B tests at scale

- Strong SQL skills and experience building clean, performant dashboards (Tableau, Looker, or similar)

- Clear communication skills, with the ability to make complex findings easy to understand

- Curiosity, a collaborative attitude, and a drive to solve hard problems

 Bonus Points

- Passion for Discord or online communities

- Experience with performance/reliability analytics for online services

- Familiarity with social or subscription products (social graphs, LTV, funnel analysis)

- Production ETL or BigQuery experience

- Experience using AI in data science work

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $160,000 to $200,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! jobs.description:
Job Description

 Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

 The Role

HIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

 Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance. Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management. Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems. Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues. Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party. Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team. Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Requirements

The following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

 Identity resolution and matching

 Design and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches. Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization. Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system's local key and the canonical party identifier.

 Golden record and survivorship

 Design golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage. Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production. Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.

 Party and relationship data modeling

 Model the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data. Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid. Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.

 Data quality and stewardship

 Build automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication. Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient. Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.

 Integration and pipelines

 Design inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems. Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency. Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.

 Cloud data platform

 Build on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold. Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.

 Graph engineering

 Implement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier. Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.

 Programming and platforms

 Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services. Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product. Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.

 Security, governance, and regulatory

 Build for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship. Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately. Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed. Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background. Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept. Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity. Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity. Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination. AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master. Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo). A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.

 Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

 MDM platforms

 Informatica: Professional or Practitioner certification in MDM, MDM SaaS or Cloud, or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), and related Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) credentials. Reltio Certified Professional, for the Reltio Connected Data Platform. Semarchy xDM certification (Discovery or Practitioner). Ataccama ONE certification. Profisee certification, particularly for teams on the Microsoft and Azure stack.

 Cloud, data platform, and graph

 Microsoft Azure: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert, given our Azure-preferred stack. Databricks or Snowflake certification where the client stacks calls for it. Neo4j Certified Professional, or an equivalent graph credential, for the relationship graph work.

 Governance and adjacent

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

In this high-visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high-performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI-native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline.

This is a high-leverage "build-the-foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence-backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision.

Your ImpactDefine the Platform Architecture: Architect a high-performance, modular core for networking, crypto, configuration, and telemetry that sibling products configure rather than rebuild.Establish Secure Seams & Extensions: Create localized plugin models so that new auth methods, protocol extensions, or tunnel types land once and become immediately available across all platforms.Systemic Quality & Reliability by Design: Own the endpoint architecture standardizing peer identity, least-privilege decomposition, resilient error handling, and memory safety directly into type systems and CI/CD gates.Pioneer AI-Native Workflows & Supportability: Integrate AI-driven software analysis, automated crash triage, and automated regression verification into standard build pipelines while driving unified crash analytics and product telemetry to maintain a world-class Crash-Free SLO across millions of active enterprise endpoints.Drive Technical Excellence: Set engineering standards, author key Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), mentor principal and senior talent, and represent our technical strategy with customers and engineering partners.

Qualifications

Minimum QualificationsSeasoned and accomplished leadership in Endpoint systems development`, core networking, and/or OS-level software development.Cross-Product Impact: Track record of defining cross-team architecture that was successfully adopted across multiple product groups.Deep OS Internals: Expert hands-on knowledge in at least two target platforms:Windows: Kernel/driver models, WFP, services, OS process architecture.macOS: XPC, System/Network Extensions, IOKit, code-signing, notarization.Linux: Netlink, routing, network namespaces, DNS handling.Legacy Refactoring: Proven experience decomposing complex C/C++ codebases into modular, testable components using incremental, safe refactoring patterns.Technical Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to align senior engineers and executives behind complex architectural shifts.Preferred QualificationsHands-on experience with VPN, ZTNA, or SASE client technologies (IPsec/IKEv2, TLS/DTLS, QUIC/MASQUE, split tunneling, posture assessment).Experience shipping multi-platform agents at scale (millions of active endpoints) with staged rollouts and telemetry-backed observability.Background integrating AI/ML models into software engineering workflows (code review, test generation, defect triage).

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

jobs.description:
Remote with occasional travel in West Midlands: In the Security Engineer role, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) is secure and protected against cyber threats.

Remote with occasional travel in West Midlands:

In the Security Engineer role, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) is secure and protected against cyber threats. Your expertise will help identify potential risks and vulnerabilities specific to OT and IT environments and develop effective mitigation strategies. By providing guidance and support, you will contribute to our vision of being a world-leading Information Technology and Digital function in the energy sector.

Key Responsibilities

 What you'll do
As an employee in the Security Engineer role, your key roles and responsibilities will include:

- Administer and maintain the End Point Security platform(s) (Tanium & Sentinel One) across enterprise environments.

- Deploy, configure, and manage End Point Security including Tanium modules including Asset, Patch, Deploy, Threat Response, and Comply.

- Monitor system performance and ensure high availability and reliability of End Point security services.

- Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and queries to support IT operations and security teams.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate End Point security services with other security and IT tools.

- Perform regular audits and ensure compliance with internal and external security standards.

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to endpoint visibility, patching, and software deployment.

- Provide training and support to internal teams on End Point security services usage and best practices.

- Stay current with Tanium/Sentinel One updates, features, and industry trends.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

-
 Tanium Certified Administrator (TCA) certification is preferable .

- Proven experience administering Tanium and other End Point security products in a medium to large enterprise environment.

- Strong understanding of endpoint management, cybersecurity principles, and IT operations.

- Experience with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation and reporting.

- Familiarity with Windows, Linux, and MacOS operating systems.

- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits

We have a high-performance culture which is balanced evenly with world-class well-being initiatives and benefits:

- Flexible Working: Balance your work and personal life with our flexible working options.

- Generous Holiday Allowance: Enjoy 25 days of holiday, plus bank holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days of annual leave.

- Medicash & Critical Illness Scheme

- Financial & Investment Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our Pension, Life Assurance, and Share Save Scheme.

- Community & Volunteering Programmes: Make a difference in your community with our volunteering opportunities.

- Green Car Scheme: Drive green and save money with our eco-friendly car scheme.

- Cycle Scheme: Stay fit and healthy with our cycle-to-work scheme.

- Special Time Off: Take time off for those big moments in life, like getting married/entering into a civil partnership, becoming a grandparent, and welcoming home a new pet.

- Family Planning: Benefit from our generous maternity and paternity leave, as well as time off and support for those undergoing fertility treatments.

jobs.title: Senior Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Operations Consultant – L3
jobs.summary: Contexte et positionnement du poste Afin de renforcer notre équipe Operations, nous recherchons un profil senior spécialisé dans les services Microsoft 365 Collaboration et Power Platform. Le poste combine un rôle de référent L3 sur Teams, SharePoint...
jobs.description:
Contexte et positionnement du poste

Afin de renforcer notre équipe Operations, nous recherchons un profil senior spécialisé dans les services Microsoft 365 Collaboration et Power Platform. Le poste combine un rôle de référent L3 sur Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive avec la responsabilité du support technique Power Platform sur nos contrats de Managed Services.

 Positionnement du poste

Il s’agit d’un rôle orienté Run et support avancé. Le collaborateur ne porte pas de projets de déploiement ou de développement de nouvelles solutions. Il intervient sur les environnements existants, leur stabilité, leur support, leur gouvernance opérationnelle et leur amélioration continue.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Microsoft 365 Collaboration – L3 Operations

 n Assurer le support de niveau 3 et le troubleshooting avancé sur les environnements Microsoft 365 de nos clients.

 n Être le référent technique de l’équipe Operations pour Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive for Business.

 n Prendre en charge les incidents complexes, problèmes et escalades provenant des équipes L1/L2.

 n Analyser les dégradations de service, problèmes de configuration, droits d’accès, synchronisation, partage et intégrations.

 n Intervenir sur Microsoft 365 Groups et sur les dépendances Entra ID liées aux services collaboratifs.

 n Piloter les escalades techniques auprès de Microsoft ou de fournisseurs tiers lorsque nécessaire.

 n Réaliser des analyses de cause racine et contribuer au Problem Management.

 n Identifier les incidents récurrents et proposer des améliorations techniques ou opérationnelles.

 n Maintenir la documentation technique, les procédures d’exploitation et les articles de connaissance.

 n Assurer le transfert de compétences et l’accompagnement technique des équipes L1/L2.

Power Platform – Référent technique L3

 n Être le point de référence technique pour le support Power Platform sur les contrats MSP pris en charge par Sword.

 n Assurer le support avancé de Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, environnements Power Platform, connecteurs et gateways.

 n Diagnostiquer les erreurs d’applications et de flows, problèmes de connecteurs, authentification, permissions et dépendances de plateforme.

 n Prendre en charge les incidents sur les solutions existantes sans responsabilité de développement de nouvelles applications.

 n Contribuer à l’administration des environnements et à la gouvernance opérationnelle de la Power Platform.

 n Coordonner avec les propriétaires d’applications, développeurs ou équipes projet lorsqu’une correction applicative ou une évolution sort du périmètre Run.

 n Construire et maintenir les procédures de support et standards opérationnels Power Platform.

Managed Services Operations

 n Gérer les incidents, problèmes et demandes de service dans nos outils ITSM, en respectant les priorités et SLA contractuels.

 n Participer aux échanges techniques avec les Service Delivery Managers et les équipes IT de nos clients.

 n Contribuer aux revues opérationnelles lorsque son expertise technique est requise.

 n Collaborer avec les spécialistes Azure, Workplace, Identity, Security et Business Applications.

 n Participer aux démarches d’amélioration continue et de capitalisation au sein de l’équipe Operations.

 n Participer au service d’astreinte lorsque le périmètre du contrat le nécessite.

Votre profil

 n Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans des environnements Microsoft, avec une expérience significative en support L2/L3 ou Managed Services.

 n Expérience solide et opérationnelle des services Microsoft 365 Collaboration.

 n Expérience concrète de l’administration et du support Microsoft Power Platform.

 n Expérience comme technical lead, référent senior, expert d’escalade ou technical advisor.

 n Capacité à diagnostiquer des problèmes complexes impliquant plusieurs services Microsoft et à identifier rapidement la cause racine.

 n Autonomie, sens du service et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques.

 n Aisance dans un environnement Managed Services avec engagement de service, priorisation et relation client.

 n Rigueur, organisation, esprit d’équipe et bonne communication.

 n Capacité à documenter clairement les sujets techniques et à transférer ses connaissances aux autres ingénieurs.

Compétences techniques

 Microsoft 365 Collaboration

 Power Platform

Microsoft Teams

Power Apps

SharePoint Online

Power Automate

OneDrive for Business

Dataverse

Microsoft 365

Connectors & integrations

Microsoft Entra ID

On-premises Data Gateway

PowerShell

Power Platform Admin Center

Compétences complémentaires appréciées

 n Microsoft Purview

 n Exchange Online

 n Microsoft Graph

 n Azure

 n Intune

 n Power Platform ALM / Solutions

 n CI/CD principles for Power Platform

Langues

 n Anglais professionnel obligatoire : niveau B2 minimum, C1 souhaité.

 n Français professionnel fortement souhaité.

 n Une autre langue européenne constitue un atout.

Ce qui caractérise le poste

 n Un rôle senior d’expertise technique centré sur le Run, le troubleshooting et la responsabilité opérationnelle.

 n Le point d’escalade L3 de référence pour Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive au sein de la BU Operations.

 n Le référent L3 Power Platform pour les contrats de Managed Services opérés par Sword.

Pourquoi rejoindre Sword ?

Organisé selon un modèle de centres de compétence spécialisés, Sword a développé une expertise forte sur les technologies Cloud Microsoft et les Managed Services.

Vous rejoignez une organisation où les équipes Operations, Collaboration, Business Applications, Workplace, Identity et Security travaillent ensemble sur des environnements clients exigeants et variés. Le poste offre un haut niveau d’autonomie et une responsabilité technique claire sur le périmètre Run.

jobs.title: Virtual Desktop Engineer
jobs.summary: Responsibilities Job Description: Peraton is seeking an experienced systems Virtual Desktop Engineer to join our national intelligence program that delivers engineering, application development, deployment, operations, upgrades and sustainment of products...
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Job Description:

Peraton is seeking an experienced systems Virtual Desktop Engineer to join our national intelligence program that delivers engineering, application development, deployment, operations, upgrades and sustainment of products and services to achieve our client's global missions.

The Virtual Desktop Engineer will have an emphasis on User Profiles.

Responsibilities:

 Manage user accounts, permissions, licenses, and monitoring of system performance to proactively resolve technical issues.

 Analyze and interpret data to improve infrastructure performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions, to include monitoring system performance and troubleshooting issues to ensure compliance with performance standards.

 Ensure data security and compliance with industry standards and regulations.

 Maintain smooth operation of multi-user computer systems, including coordination with network engineers.

 Monitor and manage enterprise system resources, including CPU usage, disk usage, and response times to maintain operating efficiency.

 Assess and remediate the enterprise design and implementation to mitigate performance and cybersecurity risks.

 Perform systems security administration functions, including creating user profiles and accounts.

 Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 problem identification, diagnosis, and resolution of problems.

 Configure operating systems and support enterprise servers.

 Install and configure database and application software.

 Perform database backups and system restoration, monitor database performance, and perform troubleshooting.

 Interact with users and interfacing applications.

 Provide hardware and software backup recovery.

 Other duties may include setting up administrator accounts, maintaining system documentation, tune system performance, installing system wide software, and allocating mass storage space.

 Develop, implement and maintain processes, procedures, test cases, test results, issue resolutions, performance analysis, and user guidelines/ instructions documentation.

**Position is Contingent on Contract Award**

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

 Active Top Secret/ Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance with ability to pass and obtain a Poly Clearance.

 Minimum of 5 years relevant experience with bachelor's degree; Minimum of 3 years with master's degree; Minimum of 0 years with PhD or 9+ years of relevant work experience can be used in lieu of a degree.

 Current CISSP or Security + Certification.

 Proven work experience as a Systems Engineer, Systems Admin or similar role in a large, distributed computing environment.

 Experience with data analysis tools, knowledge of system performance metrics, and familiarity with infrastructure management systems.

 Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

 Excellent problem-solving skills.

 Strong understanding of User Profile administration.

Desired Qualifications:

 Active TS/SCI with Poly clearances.

 Current VMware, Nutanix, or similar Certification e.g. VCP, NCP, etc.

 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

 Experience with Terraform or Ansible.

 Experience with Dell PowerFlex.

 Experience working in a large enterprise environment.

 Knowledge of storage area networks to include network operating systems, SAN protocols, SAN management, and SAN physical configuration.

 Minimum of 8-12 years' experience, in supporting virtualization technologies preferred.

 Strong understanding of data center networking (TCP/IP, switching/routing, ports and protocols, firewall concepts, load-balancing).

 Strong Scripting experience in one or more of the following: PowerShell, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, VBScript, C++, Unix Shell, Python, Perl, Ruby, JavaScript, etc.

 Strong understanding of storage protocols (e.g. NFS, SMB, S3, FC, iSCSI, NVMe).

 Good knowledge of Active Directory, DHCP, DNS, Group Policy.

 Knowledge of MS Windows Server operating systems including Server 2016, 2019, and 2022 as well as RHEL and SLES operating systems.

 Knowledge of MS database server SQL Server 2008 R2 and later.

 Knowledge of container technologies including but not limited to Docker, Kubernetes, and Rancher.

 Knowledge of IaaS in cloud using MS Azure, AWS, or GCP.

SECURITY CLEARANCE:

This Position requires an Active TS/SCI and the ability to obtain a Poly, US Citizenship is required To hold this clearance.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can't be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.
